shiyi: 此卦盘古初开天地之象。
zh.explain: 人生最好的机缘即将到来，但是要成功仍须下一番苦功夫；待到吉日良时，万事都能成就。因此你仍须忍耐，不可过于急切，要相信功到自然成。得到此签实属不易，只要为人正直、忠诚、行事不抱私心，便必定会得到领导的赏识，所以应当朝既定目标不懈奋进。
divination: 此签为上签。
好运很快就要来临，虽然好运出现的时间应在年末，但观音菩萨已用此签降下吉兆，先报给你知道了。
zh.summary: 此卦盘古初开天地之象。所祈求之事都非常吉祥。

verse: The world begins and calls for opportunity, and things will fall into place at the right time,
obtaining this lot is extremely auspicious, just like the King rewards the loyal and righteous ones.
interpretation: You are ready, the conditions are favorable, seize the opportunities, prosperity and success will be yours as the Goddess Guan Yin has indicated.
meaning: In the Pan Gu legend the creation of the world is described where all creatures will be given life.
It signifies abundance and fortune in all matters.
en.explain: You will be experiencing the best opportunity in life soon. However, in order to succeed, hard work is still required. Everything can be accomplished at the right time. Therefore, you need to be patient. Believe that achievements will take place with efforts made. It is not easy to receive this lot, and as long as one is upright, loyal and has integrity, you will be appreciated by your superior. Thus, you should make unremitting efforts towards your goal.
divination: This is an auspicious lot.
Good luck is coming soon. Although good luck will come at year end, Guan Yin Bodhisattva has already given good omen here and revealed this auspicious news to you in advance.
items: Work hard to do more good and pray for blessings
Prosperous in second half of the year
Prosperous in second half of the year
Vast offerings, pray for blessings & do dedication

zh.explain: 正如鲤鱼还没变化为龙的时候，应安守在江河中等待时机；不可以奢望得到举荐，也不可奢望让上层了解而迅速升迁。需经历许多不平凡的时日，百倍的磨砺才能功成运转，一跃过龙门。
divination: 此签为下签。
在目前情势下，应百般忍耐，以等待合适的时机。
要相信该你获得的永远都不会失去。
zh.summary: 此卦鲤鱼未变之象。所祈求之事宜忍耐，等待时机的到来。

verse: In the waters, the Koi fish quietly grows,
Not daring to aim high nor jump wide.
Comes a day when it transforms and towers.
The dragon’s gate will it leap over.
interpretation: You must put up with everything.  Be patient.  Wait for the right moment where you may build on your honor and reputation.
meaning: A Koi fish waiting patiently and unhurriedly as it completes its transformation into a dragon.
Similarly, everything has its time and place and one must wait for the right time.
en.explain: The carp stays quiet in the river before it transforms into a dragon awaiting the right timing; don't hope to be recommended or noticed by your superiors and get promoted quickly. You need to put in a lot of effort and work hard over a significant period of time to turn your fortune around and leap over the dragon gate in one fell swoop.
divination: This is an inauspicious lot.
Given the present situation, you must be patient till the right moment comes. Believe that you will never lose what you deserve to get.
items: Not safe, do more good deeds and cultivate blessings
Diligence can make up for one's weaknesses, keep working hard
Not favorable but can pray to send dedications to the animals.

notes: zh items: no 经商买卖 row; has 迁徙搬家 (not in lot 1). en items: 16 rows, no Business and no Birth row (zh has 怀孕生育); uses 'Traveller'. Double spaces after periods in en.interpretation kept as printed.

zh.explain: 经历无数挫折，不辞辛苦，忙忙碌碌地奔波劳作，就像燕子顶风冒雨衔泥筑巢，但筑成的巢不断被毁坏，不得不反复衔泥重新筑巢。
divination: 此签为下签。
虽然心机用尽，从早到晚忙个不停，但结果仍不会有更多收获，只是白白地劳心费力罢了。
zh.summary: 此卦燕子衔泥之象。所祈求之事虽劳心费力，却难有结果。

verse: A traveller returns, having braved the winds and rains.
Laboring like a homing swallow,
Which builds in vain a shelter of clay,
That collapses and disappears whenever it rains.
interpretation: Even when one tries every way and means, slogs hard day and night, all efforts will eventually be in vain.
meaning: Like a swallow which tries to build a nest with clay to protect itself against the rains, everything is laborious
en.explain: One goes through countless setbacks, undeterred by hardships, rushing and busy working, just like a swallow who braves the wind and rain to build its nest with clay. However, the nest is constantly being damaged and the swallow has no choice but to repeatedly rebuild the nest.
divination: This is an inauspicious lot.
Although you try every means working day and night, in the end, there are no additional gains and all efforts will turn out to be fruitless.
items: Bad times will pass, good times ahead

notes: zh items use 畜养动物 (not 家养动物). en.meaning has no closing period in the image. 'Change:  Auspicious' has a double space after the colon in the image (trimmed).

zh.explain: 如千年古镜重圆复明，女子能得佳婿，男子能娶贤妻，从此家事面貌一新，儿孙更是能福禄双至。
divination: 此签为上签。
如在沙中淘金一般，必历经大风大浪。
虽然劳心费力，但其中必然有所收获。
zh.summary: 此卦古镜重圆之象。所祈求之事在历经艰辛与奋斗后，会收获好成果。

verse: The ancient broken mirror is now restored,
The couple, separated, unites once more.
Henceforth, a new home is brought,
For their off-springs, more riches and joy be had.
interpretation: Sift the sands to find the gold.  Ride the dragon to trample the tiger.  Although the process is tedious, mistakes can be put right.
meaning: A broken mirror is pieced together.
All efforts to make up for past mistakes, although tedious and laborious, will be fruitful.
en.explain: An ancient mirror is restored. A woman finds a good son-in-law and a man marries a virtuous wife. From then on, the family will have a change in fortune and future generations will enjoy more riches and prosperity.
divination: This is an auspicious lot.
Just like sifting sand to find gold, one must first undergo challenges and hardships. Although the effort is laborious & painstaking, it will definitely be rewarding in the end.
items: Prosperous in second half of the year
Prosperous in second half of the year
Work harder to achieve good grades
Do more good deeds, pray for blessing and safety
Do more good deeds and pray for blessings

notes: en items: image runs 'Career: A firm conviction will succeed Academic and examination: ...' together with no line break; split into two items. 'Missing  person' has a double space in the image (normalized in key). Double spaces after periods in en.interpretation kept as printed.

zh.explain: 像用锤子凿地寻找泉水一样，虽努力谋求却难达到目的。而无意间却能偶然得遇知己，并因此携手获得较大成功。
divination: 此签为中签。
切不可认为心中的愿望到别处谋求就可能实现。还不如不动，立足当前反而可以很快实现。
zh.summary: 此卦锥地求泉之象。所祈求之事刚开始会面临困难，之后会顺利。

verse: Hammer and chisel the ground for a needed spring,
With much hard work, seeking fresh water is difficult.
Suddenly, unexpectedly, a friend comes along,
take your hand, and together you head up to the blue sky.
interpretation: What you seek can be found in the west.  Stay where you are and things will fall in place.
meaning: A man digs deep into the grounds trying to find water.  He realizes that with hard work, success can actually be obtained with ease.
en.explain: To find spring water using a hammer and chisel is hard work and difficult to achieve your goal.  Unexpectedly, you meet an old friend by chance, and by working together, you achieve greater success.
divination: This is a neutral lot.
Do not think that your wish will come true by seeking it in other places. You will be better off not moving. By staying where you are now, your wish may be fulfilled soon.
items: Accumulate merits and pray for blessings
A nobleman helps you to get ahead
Do vast offerings & dedications to get well

notes: Many en items have double spaces after the colon in the image (trimmed). Double spaces after periods in en.interpretation/meaning/explain kept as printed.

zh.explain: 得此签者，如栖身居下的大雕一样，虽身处险境，却不失大丈夫的心胸与气概，所以你所获得的富贵荣禄，别人难以得到。最终你通行天地的能力也无人能比。
divination: 此签为中签。
吃的用的少有富余，却自身清正，安贫乐道。
待到时机来临，获得的好处与快乐，也应衡量着帮助他人。
zh.summary: 此卦投岩铜鸟之象。所祈求之事宜顺应天时，则有吉祥之征兆。

verse: Sacrifice yourself to dwell in a Condor’s cave,
Perilous it may be but the stout heart that you are,
Reap rewards that none can match,
And none will roam the world as free as you.
interpretation: Food will be ample though there is little excess.  Life is poor and simple but contented.  Be patient and enjoy what you have, share your wealth and power with others.
meaning: Residing in a cave with a large condor.  Live life in accordance with your lot and fortune will follow.
en.explain: Receiver of this lot is like a condor seeking shelter. Despite being in a perilous place, you did not lose the stout heart and spirit of a true man. Therefore, the riches, glory and fortune that you achieve is something no one else can do. It means your ability to traverse heaven and earth is also unmatchable by others.
divination: This is a neutral lot.
Your resources may be scarce, but you lead a contented and upright life.
When opportunity strikes you gain benefits and happiness, which you should also share with and help others.
items: Do vast offerings & dedications to get well

notes: zh.shiyi and zh.summary print 投岩铜鸟 (铜 'copper') while the poem/explain say 雕 (condor); likely a typo for 雕鸟, copied as printed. Double spaces after colons in en items trimmed; double spaces after periods in en.interpretation/meaning kept as printed.

zh.explain: 前行的路上险阻重重，自己需要解决的问题没有解决好，却去登越高山。想到外地谋求发展，其结果必定会为万事缠绕难以归还。
divination: 此签为下签。
后退一步自然一切可得，想前进则困难重重。
应该保持现况，切不可好高骛远。
zh.summary: 此卦拖泥带水之象。所祈求之事宜维持现状则吉利。

verse: The way ahead is blocked and perilous,
As the waters drag the earth to the mountains.
If you seek work in foreign parts,
None you will find, come home instead.
interpretation: Should retreat as progress will be tough.  Should stay where you are and do not be too ambitious.
meaning: You are plodding along muddy waters.  Change is not desired and you should stay where you are.
en.explain: The path before you is filled with danger. Your problems on hand are not resolved and yet you seek to climb higher. Your wish to venture in foreign lands will end up with many obstacles and it is better to return home.
divination: This is an inauspicious lot.
Take a step back and things will be achievable, moving forward will be filled with many struggles.  You should maintain your status quo and avoid being too ambitious.
items: Accumulate merits and pray for blessings
Not favorable, accumulate merits & pray for blessings
Be down-to-earth, stay put in job
Accumulate merits and pray for blessings
Accumulate merits and pray for blessings
Need do good, pray for blessings
Do more good & pray for blessings

notes: Double spaces after colons in en items trimmed; double spaces after periods in en interpretation/meaning/divination kept as printed. 好高骛远: 骛 is best reading (could be 鹜 at this resolution).

zh.explain: 如同茂盛树林中的苍翠松柏，正处于兴旺时期，即使风霜雨雪也毫无危厄。将来如果被人委用，不仅会功成名就，而且定然成为栋梁之材。
divination: 此签为上签。
人生之路通达顺利，万事最终都能获得成功。
所播种的一切，都会成熟丰收，家境富裕，事业也必定兴旺。
zh.summary: 此卦松柏茂林之象。所祈求之事有富贵之气息。

verse: Pines and cypresses thrive and flourish,
No rain, snow, wind or frost can make them perish.
Someday when one proves his mettle,
A bulwark of society would be his mantle.
interpretation: A safe and easy journey.  Success in your whole life.
Crops will grow in abundance.
Your family will grow in prestige and wealth.
meaning: Cypresses and pine trees are growing in abundance.
There is an air of nobility in everything.
en.explain: Just like the lush cypress and pine trees in a flourishing forest, you are at your prime, even inclement weather like wind, frost, rain,& snow can do nothing to you. Should you get entrusted and engaged by someone in the future, you will not only be famous, but also a great pillar,  and a bulwark of society.
divination: This is an auspicious lot.
Your life will be smooth sailing, your endeavors will be successful. All that you sow will bear a bountiful harvest, your family will be wealthy and your business will prosper.

notes: en.explain printed 'rain,& snow' (no space) and 'pillar,  and' (double space); kept as printed. en.interpretation printed on 3 deliberate lines, split accordingly. Double spaces after colons in en items trimmed.

zh.explain: 特别应该谆谆告诫的是：为人处事要出于公心，切不可私心太重。为人正直，光明磊落，心洁如月，就可能如月当空，居高临下，惠及众人，被人景仰。
divination: 此签为中签。
只要有正直的胸怀，所做的事合乎情理，法律就不会约束到你。
但你所行之事是否合乎情理呢？圣人的评判最为公允。
zh.summary: 此卦皎月当空之象。所祈求之事以光明正直的心态行持则能实现。

verse: Cast aside your prejudices and pride,
Let your conscience be your guide
A heart that is open, pure and bright,
Shines like a full moon high in the sky.
interpretation: Be upright and unbiased.  Be impartial and uphold the principles of reason.  No saint or sage ever yields to their own desires.  Things will eventually clear up.
meaning: A full moon lights up the clear night sky.  Everything will proceed well if your intentions are good.
en.explain: Earnest cautioning: Be impartial when handling people and situations, avoid having selfish thoughts. Be upright, unbiased and an open heart is like a moon  shining bright and clear in the sky, benefiting all people below.
divination: This is a neutral lot.
So long as you are upright and fair, you will not be bound by the law.
However, are the things you do fair and reasonable?  The verdict by the sages will be the fairest of all.
items: Keep a good heart to be safe

notes: en.verse line 2 has no trailing comma in the image. en.explain has a double space in 'a moon  shining' (kept). Double spaces after colons in en items trimmed; double spaces after periods kept as printed.

zh.explain: 自己就是石头中蕴藏的珍贵宝玉，颇富才智，却一味的奢望于贵人相助和异地求财，这多么像拿着灯找火，十足的枉劳心思。
divination: 此签为中签。
所有的姻缘都会出现，做任何事情均可成功。
虽可以不限制自己的想象力，但得相信，自己眼前的一切才是真切的。
zh.summary: 此卦持灯觅火之象。所祈求之事需等待时机，之后才会成功。

verse: Hidden within are priceless jade and gems,
Yet one searches in foreign lands for the same.
Like one who seeks light while holding a lamp,
Save your troubles, pack up and head home.
interpretation: Marriage will come, everything can be accomplished.
Don’t limit yourself, what is before you is real and genuine.
meaning: A man holds a lamp and still looks for light.  Be patient and wait, success will be at hand.
en.explain: You are the precious jade hidden in the stone. While you possess talents and wisdom, yet you constantly desire for benefactor help, and seek wealth in other lands. This is just like holding a lamp to seek light, a complete waste of effort.
divination: This is a neutral lot.
All that is fated will come, doing anything can be successful. Although you do not need to limit your imagination, you have to believe what is before you is real and genuine.
items: Be down-to-earth, and wait for the opportunity.
Concentrate on studying, you will surely make progress.
Do vast offerings & dedications to get well
Although  safe, you can still pray for more blessings

notes: zh 学业考试 value ends with 。 in the image (only item that does). en 'Ancestral grave: Although  safe' has a double space (kept). Double spaces after colons in en items trimmed.

zh.explain: 相求好事会非常好，只可惜一直为亲姻所忙碌。但最终仍会成为鹿卢剑一样的宝贵人才，更会遇到贵人指给富贵之路。
divination: 此签为上签。
心中总有意识地寻求变化，但最终仍可获得安然的结局。
如要问怎么处理事情才会成功，唯有征询有识之士的意见。
zh.summary: 此卦因祸得福之象。所祈求之事宜细心规划则会吉祥。

verse: Eager and excited to pursue a victory,
Yet made busy within the family.
Eventually one will be like the imperial blade,
As a savior will be found to lead the way.
interpretation: You have the desire for changes and all will be fine in the end.  If you need guidance, your distinguished patron and help is near.
meaning: What appears as misfortune turns out to be a blessing in disguise.
Whatever you plan will be auspicious.
en.explain: Pursuing good outcomes is very good, but it is a pity you are always busy with family matters. Eventually you will become a precious talent, even meeting a savior who points you the way to prosperity.
divination: This is an auspicious lot.
There is always an intent to seek change. Yet it will turn out to be a safe ending. What can you do to succeed?  You only need to consult knowledgeable people for advice.
items: Succeed eventually with guidance from patrons
Pray for great blessings and do dedications

notes: zh.poem line 3 prints 到头竟必成鹿剑 (confirmed by zoom; traditional texts read 成中箭, explain refers to 鹿卢剑). zh items key is 官司情况 (other lots use 官司诉讼). Double spaces after colons in en items trimmed; double spaces after periods/question mark kept.

zh.explain: 厄运离去，好运来到，常发生在转瞬之间；交往上层人物，自己不久就可能从底层得到升迁。待到虎年兔年交好运时，自己为了实现志向所付出的繁忙，立即就会转变为安享成果的闲逸。
divination: 此签为上签。
人生会有大变化，就如用麻布换来丝织品，系在人的双脚上。
若要知道最后的结果，必定是因祸得福。
zh.summary: 此卦祸中有福之象。所祈求之事先有凶险，之后会吉祥。

verse: Misfortune will pass, luck will soon be with you.
Trust the gentlemen from the mountaintops, In a time ruled by Tiger or Rabbit, good news beckon.
Work with determination, success will bring leisure you will soon enjoy.
interpretation: Instead of hemp, you will receive silk for your feet.
You must be clear-headed as blessings will follow after a disaster.
meaning: This lot relates to a blessing in disguise whenever a misfortune occurs.
All misfortunes will eventually turn out fine.
en.explain: Bad luck passes, good luck comes, this often occurs in the blink of an eye; befriend people of higher status, and you will soon rise to the top. When good fortune comes in the year of the tiger and rabbit, all efforts made to achieve your ambition will immediately turn into leisure to enjoy the fruits.
divination: This is an auspicious lot.
There will be a huge change in your life. It is like exchanging linen for silk fabric, adorning your feet. For your final outcome is definitely a blessing in disguise & all will turn out well.
items: Do good deeds  & results will be successful
First work hard, good results will follow

notes: en.verse is printed as one wrapped paragraph rather than 4 lines; split at sentence breaks (mid-sentence capital 'In' kept as printed). en Career value has a double space before '&' (kept). en key 'Migrating and moving' (no 'house') as printed.

zh.explain: 从小生长在富贵人家，至今过着奢侈的生活。一旦得到君王的赏识，定能名扬四海，人人夸赞。
divination: 此签为中签。
若是犯罪入狱者必遇大赦，得了病的也必定无大碍，在升迁的路上也会大功告成，并因此名声广播，众人羡慕。
zh.summary: 此卦龙门得遇之象。所祈求之事如有变化则会非常吉祥。

verse: You were born to a wealthy family,
Into a life of riches and prestige.
Once the King grants you a golden mantle,
Across the seven seas, your fame will rattle.
interpretation: Prisoners will be pardoned. The sick will be cured.
Once at the Dragon gate, your fame will spread.
meaning: You have earned the passage to pass through the Dragon Gate, so events will turn out well.
en.explain: Being born to a wealthy family, you have lived a luxurious life since young. Once the King bestowed you a gift, it will made you world famous, and be praised by everyone.
divination: This is a neutral lot.
Prisoners will be pardoned and the sick will be cured. You will also be successful on your way to promotion and because of this, your reputation will spread far and wide, with many envying you.
items: Accumulate merits and pray for blessings
Accumulate merits and pray for blessings

notes: zh items have an extra 迁徙搬家 row (18 vs 17 in lot 1) and use 畜养动物 where lot 1 has 家养动物; en has matching 'Migrating and moving house' row and 'Traveller' label. en explain typo 'it will made' preserved.

zh.explain: 像仙鹤飞出樊笼一样摆脱困境，改变厄运，就能事事顺心，处处顺畅。自己也必能海阔天空无阻碍，任你翱翔，青云直上。
divination: 此签为中签。
应少些顾虑，行事也应更随意些，这样一路上才会顺通畅达，随心所欲，也必然能因此活得逍遥自在。
zh.summary: 此卦仙鹤离笼之象。所祈求之事先有凶险，之后会吉祥。

verse: Just like the divine crane freed from its cage,
One is released to fly wherever you may.
North, South, East, West, all paths are free,
Even up to the clouds on nine if you please.
interpretation: Everything is laid out. Every road is free.
Go as your heart desires, be free.
meaning: Analogy to the divine crane who has left its cage and regained its freedom.
All things will eventually turn out well.
en.explain: Just like the divine crane escaping from its cage, finally breaking free from bondage, your bad luck will change, and everything will go well, according to your wishes. You will be able to welcome a bright and unimpeded future, soar up in the sky without hindrance.
divination: This is a neutral lot.
You ought to worry less, life can be easier and smooth, then your path will be incomparably smooth, go as your heart desires, naturally you will live life with ease.
items: Do vast offerings & dedications to get well

notes: zh items: first key printed as 自身情况 (duplicated; en has Household, so likely a typo for 家宅情况) - preserved as printed. 解曰 last half-line printed 逍遥如人 (as printed; possibly intended 逍遥如仙). en interpretation/meaning have double spaces after periods in image, normalized to single. Extra 迁徙搬家 / Migrating row present.

zh.explain: 遇到有人一时怨气难消，就不要接近，以免招惹祸事。如果已招灾事，应如巢破了的林中鸟一样，到树林深处藏身保平安。
divination: 此签为中签。
若招惹别人，留下很深的怨恨，澄清的时机遥遥无期，即使说很好的言辞。别人也不会相信。所以宜保持现有的状况，慢慢等待时机。
zh.summary: 此卦鸟鹊离林之象。所祈求之事最终能够顺心如意。

verse: A disagreement is hard to swallow.
When troubles are near, move far away.
Like a bird whose nest has fallen,
You may only find shelter in deep places.
interpretation: If you should incur any wrath or anger, it will take time to clarify.
Even if you mean well, nobody will believe you.
Stay where you are, tolerate and bide your time.
meaning: Like a bird seeking a nesting place in a forest, you will initially encounter difficulties and hardships but all your troubles will soon be over.
en.explain: In order to avoid trouble, do not go near an angry person. If already provoked, for your own safety, you should be like a bird in the forest whose nest has been destroyed, hide in the depths of the forest and keep safe.
divination: This is a neutral lot.

If you have offended another person, and left deep resentment, with no opportunity for clarification anywhere in sight. Even if you put in very good words, the other party will not believe it. Thus, it is best to keep the current situation, and patiently wait for a suitable time.
items: Peace & harmony for the greater good
Diligence and not play has merits
Should repay wish by doing good

zh.explain: 愁容焦虑在短时间内就会消除，喜事也自会到来。就像宝玉埋藏在粪土中，一旦遇知音荐举，就能大展才华，出人头地。
divination: 此签为中签。
得到的东西没有损失，即使有损失，其间也隐藏着益处。
是小人总要遇到厄运，是君子必定会顺利吉祥。
zh.summary: 此卦阴阳和合之象。所祈求之事如果有所谋划则必定吉祥。

verse: Put aside your worries and sorrows,
As the clouds clear, joy will follow.
Like a piece of jade buried in a heap of dung,
A skilled craftsman would soon uncover its value.
interpretation: Gain and no loss. Damage will be made good.
The villain will meet his just deserts.
The virtuous will be rewarded.
meaning: Yin and Yang in harmony, what you seek will be fortuitous.
en.explain: Sadness and anxiety will clear up soon, followed naturally by happy events. Just like a precious jade buried in dirt & dung, you will be able to showcase your talent and excel above others, upon meeting one who discovers your talent.
divination: This is a neutral lot.
What you get will not be lost. Even if there is a loss, there will be hidden benefits. A villain will surely meet with bad luck, while a noble person will surely have a smooth and auspicious life.
items: Auspicious in later half of the year
Real talents and hard work will lead to success

notes: zh divination is printed as three deliberate lines (3 array entries). en interpretation double space after 'loss.' normalized. Extra 迁徙搬家 / Migrating row present.

zh.explain: 不要相信闲言，也不要说他人的是非，多用时间礼佛敬神。如果把虚言也当成了真话，其结果必定如画饼充饥空欢喜。
divination: 此签为中签。
如果自己心神不定，即便想要研读经文，却心不在焉、视而不见，岂非枉费心神。恰如在纸张上画的饼，即使吃进嘴里，也难以吞下。
zh.summary: 此封画饼充饥之象。所祈求之事虚假的成分多，真实的成分少。

verse: Pay no heed to gossip and spread no scandals.
Chant the Buddhist prayers day and night.
If you believe the lies and fallacies,
You are drawing cakes to fill your hunger.
interpretation: Prayers are wasted on a distracted and discontented heart.
Like cakes in a painting, you cannot consume them to satisfy your hunger.
meaning: This is from a Chinese proverb where a man tries to satisfy his hunger by drawing a cake.
The hunger is real but the food is not.
en.explain: Turn a deaf ear to gossip and do not gossip about others. Spend more time praying to Buddha & Bodhisattvas. If you take untrue words as truths, and believe in falsehoods, it would be like drawing a cake to relieve your hunger. Your joy will be in vain.
divination: This is a neutral lot.
Prayers are wasted on a distracted, discontented heart. This will be like drawing cakes on paper, you cannot consume them to satisfy your hunger.
items: Accumulate merits and pray for blessings

zh.explain: 太阳西下，月亮东升，日夜循环、阴阳消长是从古到今的事。僧人道人知道了这一规律就能通天彻地，士农工商懂得这规律就能各随所愿。
divination: 此签为上签。
心中坦荡，不用多疑，认真做自己该做的事情。事情做好了功业自然会成，就像弦弓上的箭一样，一当射出自然会在空中前行。
zh.summary: 此卦阴阳消长之象。所祈求之事有顺心如意的征兆。

verse: The Golden Crow sets as the Jade Rabbit rises,
Days and nights cycle since the world begins.
The Buddhist or Tao practitioners will gain much,
So will the scholar, peasant, worker or merchant.
interpretation: Free your heart of cares. Your efforts will be rewarded.
Like an arrow on a bow, it will be a clear shot on release.
meaning: The exchange of Yin and Yang symbolizes the natural order.
Harmony will prevail as things take its natural cause.
en.explain: The sun sets in the west and the moon rises from the east. The cycle of day & night, the ebb and flow of yin & yang are known facts since ancient times. When Monks & Taoists know this law, they can understand every phenomenon on earth. So scholars, peasants, worker and merchants who know this, will get what they wish for.
divination: This is an auspicious lot.

Be magnanimous in your heart, there is no need to be overly suspicious, earnestly do the tasks you should do. Once these tasks have been completed, your work will naturally succeed. This is just like an arrow on a stretched bow string, once released, the arrow will naturally soar into the sky.
items: Should do vast offerings and dedications

notes: en explain has a deliberate line break after the first sentence ('...from the east.'); joined into one string per schema. en 'take its natural cause' (sic) preserved. en double spaces after periods normalized. Extra 迁徙搬家 / Migrating row present.

zh.explain: 正如行船到了急流险滩，难以排除险阻危难。要想求得安稳，只有等待风平浪静、时来运转，危难才会自然化解。
divination: 此签为中签。
像在激流险滩处行船一样，应当在危险时静待时机。当前不是时候，不要动作。当等待这状况过后再进行谋求。
zh.summary: 此卦船行急滩之象。所祈求之事应安于现状，等待时机。

verse: Set the ferry homebound in treacherous waters,
Winds and waves roll and surge to no end.
To seek stability and calm,
Wait for quieter waves as this danger passes.
interpretation: Sail the boat in precarious conditions.
Wait for your moment in treacherous times.
Seize your chance and press ahead when conditions improve.
meaning: The image of a boat traveling on the rapids.
In everything you do, wait patiently & remain as before.
en.explain: Just as a boat reaches the rapids, it is difficult to eliminate the dangers. To seek stability, the only way is to wait for calm weather to return. Then fortune will turn and the crisis will naturally be resolved.
divination: This is a neutral lot.

Just like a boat sailing through swirling rapids, it is better to be patient and wait for the right moment in times of danger. Now is not the right moment to act. Wait for the situation to pass before taking action.
items: Accumulate merits and pray for blessings
Accumulate merits and pray for blessings
Accumulate merits and pray for blessings

notes: zh 工农商业 value printed 宜安耐等待时机 (安耐 as printed, standard is 按捺/安分). en double spaces after periods normalized. Extra 迁徙搬家 / Migrating row present.

zh.explain: 正当春天，绵绵细雨终于停了，天空突然放晴，太阳与月亮开始变得明朗。过去的事情过去了，新开始的事都很顺，万象更新，如同鱼跳过了龙门。
divination: 此签为中签。
有神灵、菩萨的保佑护持，即使有灾难发生，也没有实质性的危险。
一生平安，最后能获得荣华富贵。
zh.summary: 此卦久雨初明之象。所祈求之事能顺心如愿。

verse: As the Spring weather clears after a wet spell,
The Golden Crow and Jade Rabbit can now be seen.
As the old dissipates, the new arrives,
One jump is all it needs to clear the Dragon Gate.
interpretation: Protected by celestial beings, disasters may come but there will be no danger.
Your whole life, you will be safe and sound, and enjoy honors and glory at the end.
meaning: The image of clear weather after continuous rain, signifies that everything will be in your favor.
en.explain: With the arrival of spring, the continuous drizzle finally stops. The sky suddenly lightens. The sun and the moon begin to become brighter. What is past has passed. The future as a new beginning is smooth sailing. All things take on a new aspect, like a fish that leaps over the dragon gate.
divination: This is a neutral lot.

Deities and bodhisattvas give their protection and support. Thus, even if disasters happen, there is no apparent danger. One will be safe and sound throughout one’s life. Ultimately, one will acquire status and wealth.
items: Accumulate merits and pray for blessings
The time has come, hard times are over
Cultivate merits & wisdom to help in exams

notes: zh 解曰 third half-line printed 途生平安 (as printed; 签解 paraphrase says 一生平安). zh divination printed as three deliberate lines. en typos preserved: 'Wil be found', lowercase 'will find days later'. en double spaces after periods normalized. Extra 迁徙搬家 / Migrating row present.

zh.explain: 阴阳谐和是自然规律，男女婚嫁定然亲密欢喜。待到龙年蛇年，就会孕育男孩，家庭更美满，家人添欢欣。
divination: 此签为上签。
谋划仕途获得高升，能符合最初的愿望；婚姻也和合，并且会生育男孩；资财会有所增益，对于农事耕作，更是大有收获。
zh.summary: 此卦阴阳道合之象。所祈求之事皆谐和顺畅，非常吉利。

verse: Heaven decrees how Yin and Yang harmonizes,
Happy is the union of a man and his wife.
As when the dragon or snake arrives to meet,
A happy family reunites with dreams of heirs.
interpretation: Whatever you wish for will materialize, including marriage and a son.
Wealth and money will come.
It is even better for the crops.
meaning: When Yin and Yang are in harmony; things are expected to go well.
en.explain: Just as the harmony of yin and yang is the law of nature, matrimony for a man and woman will certainly give rise to intimacy and happiness. In either the year of the Dragon or year of the Snake, the sign points to the birth of a boy, enhancing the family's bliss and joy.
divination: This is an auspicious lot.

Prospect for career promotion is high, coinciding with one’s initial aspiration. Marriage is also harmonious, you will have a baby boy; your wealth will grow, and farming will get an even greater harvest.

notes: zh poem 2nd half-line 女嫁男婚喜偎然: 偎 read from small bold type (matches the traditional text). en meaning is wrapped after the semicolon; kept as one string. en double spaces (after 'son.', 'Traveller:') normalized. Extra 迁徙搬家 / Migrating row present.

zh.explain: 干旱致使田间禾苗都干枯了，一场好雨降临，花果树木都得到滋润，才明白这一场雨价值千金，非常可贵。
divination: 此签为中签。
农作物的收成翻倍，好运也渐渐来临。
如果得病也必能得遇良药，外出远行的人也即将返回。
zh.summary: 此卦旱逢甘雨之象。所祈求之事即使遭遇困境也能获得救护。

verse: The paddies were dried during the drought.
Thanks to the heavens, a heavy shower finally came.
The flowers, fruits and plants are now nourished,
Worth its weight in gold, this shower promised.
interpretation: A bountiful crop harvest. Luck is gradually improving.
The sick will find a beneficial cure.
The traveler may return.
meaning: This lot uses the image of drought meeting sweet rain to imply there is salvation in all difficulties.
en.explain: The drought has caused the grain crop seedlings to wither. After a bout of rain, the trees, flowers and fruits are nourished. From this we understood that this bout of rain is worth a thousand gold and is very precious.
divination: This is a neutral lot.
Harvesting of farmed crops will be doubled. Good luck is also around the corner. Should you be sick, you will certainly get good medicine Those who travel afar will also return soon.
items: Do more good deeds, pray for blessing and safety
Need to work harder and rewards will follow
Do vast offerings & dedications to get well

zh.explain: 很想找到进身机会，岂料门路不通，难获得机会。忽然遇到知音赏识，并得到提携，便会有人人笑着来贺喜的热闹场景。
divination: 此签为中签。
行商做买卖，想增加收入，但暗中却充满了危险。
若是生病，则会平安痊愈；若是想打官司，则能遂心如意，完全可放心去做。
items: 努力用功，虚心向人请教
zh.summary: 此卦手扳仙桂之象。所祈求之事必会有贵人协助。

verse: Trying to enter the Toady palace with a laurel branch.
But alas! Heaven’s gate shuts you out.
Then suddenly received some good news.
Soon everyone is smiling and celebrating.
interpretation: Trade will be profitable but there may be dangers within.
Lawsuit is in your favor and the sick will be cured.
Do your best and you will be fine.
meaning: Trying to pluck a branch from a magical laurel tree.
You will receive timely help from distinguished people
en.explain: As much as one wishes for promotion opportunities, without the right social connection, it is blocked & difficult to materialize. Suddenly you encounter a bosom friend who appreciates, supports and guides you along. Then many people will smilingly come to congratulate you, celebrating the occasion.
divination: This is a neutral lot.

Doing business is to increase profits but there lies many hidden risks. Should you be sick, you'll recover; should there be a lawsuit, it will be in your favor, thus you can be completely at ease & confident to accomplish all things.
items: Accumulate merits and pray for blessings
Do your best, will get what you wish
Put in diligent efforts & seek advice from others humbly
Accumulate merits and pray for blessings
In danger, need to be careful
Auspicious to remain as it is.

zh.explain: 缺乏认知、无独到见解、随波逐流的愚昧人，会像花儿一样很易衰败。如果想得到生活的恩赐，必须努力，不然到头来才知道所有的事情乱如麻。
divination: 此签为下签。
必须小心，不要轻易议论别人的是非。
只有心地正直，做事符合情理，才能避免灾难和危险。
items: 避免固执己见而陷入是非
zh.summary: 此卦痴人道塞之象。所祈求之事应安守现状以等待时机。

verse: Poor reasoning cannot stand on its own,
Like a fallen flower, a fickle fool drifts.
Only with much effort will any help proffers,
Else a heap of troubles is all that is on offer.
interpretation: Do not gossip or spread any rumors.  Be careful and meticulous.  Stay upright and honest to keep yourself out of harm’s way.
meaning: The idiotic image of a fool blocked in spiritual practice.
Always keep the old and wait for the time.
en.explain: A foolish person who is lacking in correct views, unknowledgeable and without direction, will wither just like a flower. In order to have a blessed life, it is necessary to work hard. Or else in the end, everything will be in a mess.
divination: This is an inauspicious lot.
Be careful, do not gossip or spread rumours about others. As long as you maintain your righteousness and are reasonable, you will be able to avoid disaster and danger.
items: Not smooth, better to wait for right time
Avoid stubbornness & getting caught up in gossips
Results is not favorable, need to work harder
Accumulate merits and pray for blessings
Seek immediate medical help and take refuge in the Triple Gems

zh.explain: 经历了不少忧患险情，从今再度创业不会落空了。少了担忧自然该有不担忧的计划，值得宽慰的是，如果遇到高人相助，还可能获得大的成功。
divination: 此签为中签。
如果打官司能占理；如果得病则能安然康复；如果做事则应多多地谋划、考虑周全，如果这样便能重获帮助和支持。
zh.summary: 此卦古井逢泉之象。所祈求之事获得贵人的协助而得到成就。

verse: One has met with sorrows, dangers and hardships,
Henceforth, plans revived will prosper.
A broad mind with a broader scheme,
Success will come with help from a distinguished patron.
interpretation: Lawsuit will be settled.  The sick will be cured and saved.  Like the well that is replenished is how you will find your fortune.
meaning: Just like an old well that is replenished with spring water, with help from distinguished patrons, you will be successful.
en.explain: Having gone through many worries and crises, starting a business again, you will survive and not fail.  With less worry, it is natural to have a plan with no apprehension and it is reassuring that you may even achieve great success if you encounter help from a benefactor.
divination: This is a neutral lot.

If you have lawsuits, you can justify; if you get sick, you will recover safely; if you do things, you should plan carefully and consider all possibilities, and if so, you can get help and support again.
items: Not favorable, the overall plan must be well thought out.
Need to be broad-minded and asks more humbly
Should study hard and ask for advice
Do more good & pray to seek blessings

shiyi: 凡事虚多实少宜守旧也。
zh.explain: 天边传来好消息，说我定能功成名就，所有的传言皆不真实，到最后，也是一派虚言。
divination: 此签为中签。
想得太多，心中自然烦恼丛生。想求得安闲，当然就不会安闲。
对于功名利禄等欲望，保持平常心态，则能获得宁静安详。
items: 保持清明理智，安住现况
zh.summary: 此卦虚名之象。所祈求之事不切实际的多，实实在在的少，宜守旧。

verse: A message distorted as it travels down from the top,
From the edge of heaven, a letter is received.
It claims to offer rank and honor to one self,
Yet proves to be only false in the end.
interpretation: Burden oneself with too many thoughts and concerns, hence one is not able to enjoy being idle.  Instead of concerning yourself with rank and title, it is better to stay and manage your present affairs well.
meaning: An empty name and title. Many things are false and not what they seem and you should keep to conventions and traditions.
en.explain: Excellent news spread, saying that I will succeed and achieve fame. However, all these rumours are untrue and groundless, it is just gossip in the end.
divination: This is a neutral lot.

Thinking too much and you will be filled with afflictions. One will not have the peace and serenity that one desires. With regards to desires for fame and wealth, maintain a neutral mind and you will be able to get peace and bliss.
items: Do good, pray for blessings & protection
Good to keep clear and sensible, stay in the present situation.
Should do more good deeds and pray for blessings.
Do more good, pray for blessings

zh.explain: 所有的计划都流于文字，仍然瞻前顾后不敢施行。时机来时，得到贵人的帮助，方能立身坚固，平平安安。
divination: 此签为中签。
把旧日的东西换成崭新的，就会像寒冬里枯萎的花草遇到春风一样，会立即生机勃勃。虽然从前多有阻碍，不太顺利，但如今终于能够称心遂意了。
items: 改变方式，虽辛苦而有收获。
zh.summary: 此卦屋好墙壁之象。所祈求之事稳妥而没有危险。

verse: Every move is carefully planned,
You consider much but fear to do much.
Until such time when distinguished help arrive,
Then a place steady as a rock you may find.
interpretation: Replace old with new.  Like the arrival of Spring when flowers bloom again, what was holding you back is now gone and things will go as you wish..
meaning: A good house with strong walls, everything will be stable with minimum risk or danger.
en.explain: All the plans are mere words, and still you are overly cautious, afraid to execute it. When opportunity comes, and with the help of a nobleman, you will be able to stand firm and enjoy peace.
divination: This is a neutral lot.

Replace old things with brand new ones. It is like withered flowers and plants in winter that meet the  spring wind and they immediately become full of vitality. Even though there were lots of obstacles in the past and things were not going too smoothly,  but now things can finally be satisfactory to one's liking.
items: Changing to new, is difficult but rewarding.
Need time to rest, no big obstacles
Status quo will bring great luck

zh.explain: 东边天空月色正好，顷刻间却被浮云遮蔽变暗。正如圆缺明暗是互相转化的，眼前的这些非议也不过是闲言罢了。
divination: 此签为中签。
即使月亮被浮云遮蔽了，也不要产生疑惑。等到浮云散去，自然会见到好结果。
zh.summary: 此卦月被云遮之象。所祈求之事目前仍处于迷茫而不稳定的状态。

verse: The pale moon rises from the east,
Obscured at times by the clouds, unseen yet present.
At times, it’s round. At times, it’s crescent.
The truth, hidden by idle talk, is not present.
interpretation: The fleeting clouds cover the moon.  Do not hesitate.
When the clouds have passed, you will see the rewards.
meaning: The moon is obscured by clouds.  Things are hazy and uncertain at the moment.
en.explain: The moonlight in the eastern sky was so beautiful, but suddenly it was obscured by the floating clouds and became dark. Just like the natural transformation of the moon, which interchanges between being bright when it is full and dark when it is not, the criticisms in front of us are merely idle words.
divination: This is a neutral lot.
Even though the moon is covered by the floating clouds, do not have any doubts. When the clouds disperse, you will naturally be able to see good results.
items: Do more good, pray for blessings
Can’t see results, wait for right timing
Gather good karma and wait for the opportunity to act.
Not favorable, need to work harder
Difficult to recover, need to gather blessings

zh.explain: 像宝剑一样，以前在匣中就一尘不染，现在出匣更是明洁光亮。得到贵人提携，也就更有威势，也令众人十分钦佩。
divination: 此签为中签。
像出匣的宝剑一样，光辉照万里。如果遇上贵人指引，必将获得成功，让众人赞美不已。
items: 提升专精技能，有助未来
zh.summary: 此卦宝剑出匣之象。所祈求之事可做得有声有势。

verse: The supreme sword, unsheathed, dazzles,
No dust or filth can make its shine frazzles.
As a distinguished person now is here,
A might and power for all to hear.
interpretation: The supreme sword is drawn, dazzling many for miles.
With guidance from a distinguished person, all will be good to behold.
meaning: A powerful sword is drawn from its sheath.
A show of power and might.
en.explain: Like a precious sword that is untainted by even a speck of dust when in the sheath.  Now, it is even brighter and shinier when out of the sheath. With the help from a nobleman, it is even more powerful, and admired by everyone.
divination: This is a neutral lot.
Like an unsheathed precious sword that glitters and shines for miles.
If you meet a nobleman and are guided by him, you'll certainly attain success and be praised by all men.
items: Enhance specialized skills for the future
