zh.explain: 不要不择对象就随便求人，以防别人表面相助却投来暗箭。正如拾柴，要提防被草中的毒蛇咬伤，带来忧患。
divination: 此签为中签。
闭上嘴巴，合上牙齿，对不关乎自己的事情不要去理会。
如果做了亏心事，到头来也定然会祸害到自己。
zh.summary: 此卦安份守己之象。所祈求之事一定要小心谨慎。

verse: Thou shalt not seek help from just anybody,
Beware of a hidden arrow disguised as a flying crane.
When gathering firewood in the field, a snake may lie in wait.
With venom that brings none but grief.
interpretation: Keep your mouth shut.  Don’t get involved in others’ affairs.  You will pay the price if you do anything against your conscience.
meaning: Be content with your lot & not be ambitious.
Be careful and cautious in everything.
en.explain: Do not indiscriminately seek help from just anyone. This is to avoid falling into the trap of people pretending to help you on the surface, yet casting a secret arrow from behind. Just like when gathering firewood, one must guard against being bitten by poisonous snakes in the grass, which will bring misery.
divination: This is a neutral lot.
Keep your mouth shut and do not get involved in affairs that do not concern you.  You will surely pay the price if you do anything against your conscience.
items: Not favorable, rational judgment is appropriate
Be content with your lot, mind your own business
Not favorable, be more diligent to make up for your weaknesses.

notes: zh uses 安份守己 in 诗意/签语 but 安分守己 in 工作事业, both as printed. en verse lines 3-4 are printed wrapped ('...a snake may lie in / wait. With venom...'); split at the sentence break. 'Business:  Standstill' extra space normalized.

zh.explain: 清静无为，纯任自然，饭后喝茶困倦就睡。闲下身心不用忙忙碌碌，就一定不会招来冤屈祸患。
divination: 此签为中签。
保持现状，多敬神礼佛，必定怡然平安。
即使时运到来，生活状态发生变化，那也是偶然的。
zh.summary: 此卦守旧安然之象。所祈求之事应等待时机的来临，则吉祥顺利。

verse: An idle life of ease and quiet,
Drinks tea after a hearty meal, rests when one is weary.
Laid your burdens to rest, live life with no hurry,
No grief or disaster will ever come along.
interpretation: Stay calm and let things remain.  The celestial advice for your question is to wait for the time to come when things will eventually fall in place.
meaning: Take it easy and let things remain.
Everything will turn out well in time to come.
en.explain: Have an idle life of peace and nature, enjoy a cup of tea after a meal and rest when tired. Relax yourself with no need to lead a busy life, and you will not encounter misfortunes and disasters.
divination: This is a neutral lot.
Maintain the current status, make more offerings to the Buddha, and you will be safe and sound. When the time comes, things will fall in naturally.
items: Accumulate merits and pray for blessings
Maintain current situation & wait for right time

notes: zh.explain begins its second sentence with 闲下身心 (poem has 放下身心), copied as printed.

zh.explain: 人才被埋没，就像玉藏石中，无人知晓，自然前景渺茫。而一旦被人发现，便能稳稳当当成为人中壁玉。
divination: 此签为中签。
就像藏在石头中的宝玉一样，有卓越才能的人也少为人知。
只要被人发掘出来，则可以尽情作为。
zh.summary: 此卦剖石见玉之象。所祈求之事能勤勉奋斗则可成功。

verse: Prospects for one’s future seem undoubtedly distant,
As a jade hidden in a stone, none can tell.
Until one day a skilled craftsman takes it out,
Only then will others appreciate its true value.
interpretation: Like priceless gems embedded in rocks, your talents lay hidden.  When these can be uncovered, you will be able to make good use of them.
meaning: Jade is found only when the stone is cut.  Success can only be possible through determined efforts.
en.explain: A talent undiscovered is like a piece of jade hidden in a rock, naturally the prospects for finding it are slim.  Once it is uncovered, will others appreciate your true value and know you are the best talent among all.
divination: This is a neutral lot.
Like priceless gems hidden in the rocks, people with outstanding talents are not widely known. Once it is discovered, you can have accomplishments and do whatever you want.
items: Put in diligent efforts to succeed
You must work hard to get good grades.
Not so safe, pray more to ask for blessings

notes: zh.explain prints 人中壁玉 (壁, likely intended 璧) and zh 祖坟牌位 prints 改变可趣向吉利 (趣, likely intended 趋); both kept as printed. 渺茫 in zh.explain is slightly small but reads as 渺茫.

zh.explain: 自己内心犹藏着无价珍宝，所以想得到美玉便没必要外求，不如等待高人的赏识，对此你完全可以放宽心。
divination: 此签为中签。
自己本身就具备很高的才能和美德，为什么要向外界寻求呢？
如果能得到贵人的指引，便不必费心费力却投报无门。
zh.summary: 此卦藏玉外觅之象。所祈求之事只需等待时机的到来。

verse: Hidden within are priceless gems and jewels,
Outside, one searches in vain for the same.
Why not wait for the right connoisseur,
Who will open your mind to the treasures within?
interpretation: Gold and jade are hidden within yet you continue a futile search outside and beyond.  You will receive guidance and no longer have to labor.
meaning: A jade is hidden nearby yet one searches far away for gems.  Be patient and wait for the right time.
en.explain: Everyone has priceless virtues hidden within our hearts. Therefore, you need not seek externally for them. It is better to wait for the right mentor to open your mind.  This you can be assured.
divination: This is a neutral lot.
Why seek externally for talents and virtues which you already have? If you can have a benefactor to guide you, you won't have to work so hard.
items: Accumulate merits and pray for blessings
Keep present status and wait for opportunity

notes: zh 诗意 first line ends with a full-width comma (，) rather than 。, as printed. zh 签解 '却投报无门' copied as printed (unusual phrasing).

shiyi: 此卦红日当空正照之象。
zh.explain: 任何时候都讲礼义，为人谦恭，语言真诚、善良的人，确实让人信从。内心不明白时，姑且静心省虑，事情自然会清楚，事业也自然会兴旺。
divination: 此签为中签。
心中不要想得太多，应该像秋水一样澄清明静，更不必疑神疑鬼，事情自然会水到渠成。
zh.summary: 此卦红日当空正照之象。所祈求之事能顺心如意。

verse: Conduct your life with dignity and propriety,
Speak and act with honesty and sincerity.
A heart that harbors no malice has clarity,
As bright as the rays of the Sun will be.
interpretation: Do not burden the heart needlessly.  It is clear and tranquil like waters in autumn.  Do not doubt anymore as the natural course of things is such that things will work out eventually.
meaning: The Sun shines brightly in the middle of the day.
Everything will be as you wish.
en.explain: It is advisable to observe etiquette at all times, be humble, sincere and kind then people will indeed trust you. Even if you have doubts, you can discern calmly, things will naturally be clear, then your business will naturally prosper.
divination: This is a neutral lot.
Do not worry too much, your mind should be clear and tranquil like the water in autumn. Do not even doubt and be suspicious as the natural course of things is that it will work out eventually.

notes: zh 签解 second part wraps after a comma ('…更不必疑神疑鬼，' / '事情自然会水到渠成。'); treated as one sentence, kept in one string.

zh.explain: 振作精神，改变门风，正说困顿无穷尽时却已有了功业。扫除了人生途中的艰难险阻，如果有人同心合作，事业自然更易成功。
divination: 此签为中签。
用不着忧愁迟疑，一切事情自然会有好的结果。
如果是问前程，前面的路途还适宜走下去的。
zh.summary: 此卦衣冠重整之象。所祈求之事刚开始会遭遇困境，但之后能化险为夷。

verse: Rebuild your coffers, restore your family name,
The path ahead is tough but there will be rewards.
Clear the path of thorns and thistles,
With consensus, an agreement can be forged.
interpretation: Do not doubt nor worry, a lucky break is ahead.
If you are asking about your future, you should just proceed.
meaning: The image of reorganization.
Everything is usually difficult at first but gets easier afterwards.
en.explain: Pull yourself together, change your style, even when the hardship is endless there are already merits. Clear the hardships and obstacles in your life journey, and with consensus among partners, business is more likely to succeed.
divination: This is a neutral lot.
There is no need to worry or hesitate, everything will naturally turn out well.
If you are asking about your future, the journey ahead is still suitable.
items: Put in best effort and work harder
Do good, pray for blessings & protection

notes: zh items: key printed as 畜养动物 (lot 1 has 家养动物); extra item 迁徙搬家 / 'Migrating and moving house' present (18 items). 家宅情况 separator looks like a full-width semicolon (；) rather than a colon in the image. en 'Ancestral grave' value ends with a period as printed.

zh.explain: 如果目前有疾病或官司，也不必忧虑，求财也能轻易获得。正如猴子挣脱了锁链，回到山洞自由游乐。
divination: 此签为中签。
摆脱了困境，除却了烦恼之事，暂且把心放宽，等到机会来临，就可走上正道。
zh.summary: 此卦猿猴脱锁之象。所祈求之事刚开始会有些困难，之后能顺利缓解。

verse: Fret not of illnesses and disagreements before you,
Riches and resources are there for your picking.
Like a monkey that’s freed of its golden chain,
Roaming freely among mountains and caves.
interpretation: Get rid of your worries and troubles.  Broaden your mind.
Wait for the right time and the right path will open for you.
meaning: A monkey escaped from its chain.  Things will get easier once you have overcome the difficulties and hardships.
en.explain: If you are sick or involved in a lawsuit, there is no need to worry, even wealth can easily be obtained. Just like a monkey that is free from its chain, it is able to return, roam freely in its mountain cave.
divination: This is a neutral lot.
Once your worries and troubles are overcome, open your mind and wait for the right opportunity to come, then you can embark on the right path to success.
items: Wait for a change to succeed
Put in best effort and work harder
Do good & pray for blessing, protection

notes: zh items: key printed as 畜养动物; extra item 迁徙搬家 present. en uses a curly apostrophe in 'that’s'. Double spaces after periods in en interpretation/meaning kept as printed.

zh.explain: 待到身心安宁、时运来临的时候，又将面临现实名利与长远理想之间的抉择。与其左右不定，不如放弃谋求名利，寻求更深层次修炼。或许在灯光的摇曳中心境平静了，一切也就看明白了。
divination: 此签为中签。
在宁静淡泊外安身，等待改变命运的时机。如果逆潮流而动，必定不会带来福分。只有保持现状，才不会产生疑惧。
zh.summary: 此卦风摇灯烛之象。所祈求之事固守着原来的做法，则会吉祥。

verse: With health, peace and fortune, one wonders what would be next.
Like a lighted candle flickering in the wind,
Better to retire and stay within,
As a quiet and humble life is just as bright.
interpretation: Retire to a quiet and secluded place.  Do nothing but wait.
Any movement may bring misfortune so your best guard is to be still and stay calm.
meaning: A lighted candle flickering in the wind.
It is best to withdraw and maintain status quo.
en.explain: When peace of mind and good fortune come, we will face the choice between real fame & fortune and long-term ideals. Instead of being uncertain, it is better to give up the pursuit of fame and fortune and seek deeper cultivation, perhaps in the flickering of the lights, the mind becomes calm and everything will be clear.
divination: This is a neutral lot.

Stay at a quiet, secluded place and wait for the opportunity to change your destiny.  If you go against the trend, it will definitely not bring blessings. Only by maintaining the status quo, will there be no doubts.
items: Time has not come, so will not have success yet
Accumulate merits and pray for blessings
Do vast offerings for blessings & dedications

notes: No 寻失物 / 'Missing things' item on either page (17 items); extra 迁徙搬家 item present; key printed as 畜养动物. zh divination reads 在宁静淡泊外安身 as printed (外 is likely a typo for 处). en verse lines 1-2 wrap mid-sentence in the image; split at clause ends. en divination 'Only by...' starts a new line in the image but appears to be a wrap, kept in the same string (matching the zh paragraph).

zh.explain: 心地坦诚地期盼好光景，等来的却是云雾遮蔽，前景迷茫。与其用很多心思祈求云开雾散，还不如多做善事，礼敬佛菩萨。
divination: 此签为下签。
家中恐有凶险的事发生，家庭成员中也恐有人会遭遇灾难。
想做法事祈福求保，却又担心会破财。
zh.summary: 此卦云雾遮月之象。所祈求之事未能顺心如愿，宜保持原来的状况。

verse: The moon shines silently onto the house,
Sudden clouds and fog dims the beam.
Pray generously and wait for the fog to lift,
Now is the time for more meaningful deeds.
interpretation: Outlook for the family is ominous, there may be disaster or sorrow.  Pray for protection and stay optimistic but be prepared for any loss of fortune.
meaning: The moon is overshadowed by clouds and fog.
Your wishes are yet to be fulfilled, you should let things remain status quo.
en.explain: You sincerely hoped for a good situation, but what came was like being covered by clouds, meaning the prospects are confused. Rather than praying for the clouds to disappear, it is better to spend time doing more charity and praying to the Buddha and deities.
divination: This is an inauspicious lot.
Outlook for the family is ominous, likely to encounter disaster or grief.
You wish to pray & seek blessings and protection, but yet you worry about the costs.
items: Do good pray for blessings & protection

notes: zh item key printed as 失物 (not 寻失物) and 畜养动物; extra 迁徙搬家 item. en 'Sickness:' has a double space after the colon in the image (trimmed).

zh.explain: 远方将有消息传来，好坏难以猜测。切记不要一个心思就想着好事，是坏消息的可能也许更大。如果想把粗劣的石头磨成明亮的镜子，这种枉费工夫的事最好不要去做。
divination: 此签为下签。
耗尽心机，不停地奔波忙碌，到头来也是白费工夫。
保持原来的样子又有什么不好呢？
items: 成绩未如理想，要多下苦功
zh.summary: 此卦守常安静之象。所祈求之事能安分守己则吉祥。

verse: A message from afar is hard to predict,
Yet do not place too much hope nor high expectations.
Know that to turn a stone into a mirror,
Will be both laborious and fruitless.
interpretation: All efforts and schemes will be in vain.
Better to remain as-is and plan accordingly.
meaning: Stick to established ways and be still.
Keep things as they are and you will be fine.
en.explain: News from afar is difficult to predict if it's good or bad.  Remember not to think about good things only, the possibility of bad news may be greater. It will be a waste of one's efforts trying to polish a rough stone into a clear mirror. Best not do it.
divination: This is an inauspicious lot.
Despite putting in so much effort running around, busying yourself continuously, all your efforts will be wasted in the end. So what is wrong with remaining status quo?
items: Grades are not as expected, more hard work is needed
Do vast offerings & pray for blessing to be safe

notes: zh poem last half-line read as 曾知枉费己工夫 (glyph looks like 己, not 已; as printed). zh item key printed as 官司情况 (not 官司诉讼) and 畜养动物; extra 迁徙搬家 item. en 'Difficult To find' capital T as printed; double spaces after colons in 'Change:' and 'Sickness:' trimmed; double space after 'bad.' in explain kept.

zh.explain: 太阳西下，月亮东升，阴长阳消，百事消停。如果能让女人发挥更多作用，则必定能增添财禄，自己也会感到更幸福。
divination: 此签为中签。
阴柔的环境更有利于女人，不适宜于男人。
如果是问谋划中的事情，则必定是先凶后吉。
items: 即使寻找，到头来仍是一场空
zh.summary: 此卦阴长阳消之象。所祈求之事刚开始会蒙受困难，但之后亦能迎刃而解。

verse: The red wheel sets in the West as the rabbit rises in the East.
Things remain even as the lunar grows in strength and the solar wanes.
If a woman is seeking to divine her future,
She will be blessed with wealth, riches and fortune.
interpretation: A “Yin” Lot is favorable if the question involves a female.
Otherwise, for a male seeking his fortune, it will be ominous before it will turn better.
meaning: A strong “Yin” (Moon) presiding over a declining “Yang” (Sun).  There will be difficulties initially but these will soon pass and things will get easier.
en.explain: When the sun sets in the west, the moon will rise in the east. With the Yin growing stronger, the Yang will weaken, and everything will come to a stop. Therefore, if females are allowed to take on greater roles, it will surely bring on more wealth and good fortune, and one will feel happier too.
divination: This is an inauspicious lot.
A “Yin” environment is more advantageous to females and is unsuitable for males. If you are asking about what is being planned, it will initially be bad, before turning into auspicious.
items: Do good, pray for blessings & protection
Put in more hard work to see improvements
Even if search, will be empty eventually

notes: en divination says 'This is an inauspicious lot.' although Prophesy is Neutral and zh says 此签为中签 (image error, copied as printed). en Lot Verse is printed as wrapped prose (not 4 lines); split at sentence/clause breaks. Curly quotes “ ” kept as printed. zh key printed as 畜养动物; extra 迁徙搬家 item.

zh.explain: 特别好的话你该记住，更不要干出认贼作子的事情。不要贪图眼前的一点儿甜头，要考虑将来怎么收场。
divination: 此签为中签。
认贼作子这些事，凡是有眼光的人都不会这么做，要时时牢记在心，这样才不会在某个时候心生担忧。
zh.summary: 此卦认贼作子之象。所祈求之事需认真辨识，以防虚假。

verse: Endless meaningful words you do take in,
Yet you mistaken the thief for a son.
Do not hunger after the spoils you see now,
Look into the past for lessons you must remember.
interpretation: A single mistake can translate into a lasting regret.
Remember this and you will not be left out.
meaning: Like a man who is tricked into treating a thief like his own son.  Be careful not to be deceived by falsehood.
en.explain: You must remember especially good advice given. More importantly, do not treat a thief as your son. Do not be deceived by a little goodness you see in the present. It is necessary to consider carefully about the future consequences.
divination: This is a neutral lot.
Any wise man with foresight would not make the mistake of treating a thief as a son.  This you should always remember.  Then you won’t have to worry all the time.
items: Maintain status quo and wait for the right opportunity
Work harder, make up for your weaknesses with diligence
Accumulate merits, pray for blessings and protection
Do vast offerings for blessings and dedications

notes: zh 出门在外 value has an extra leading space in the image (trimmed). zh key printed as 畜养动物; extra 迁徙搬家 item. en: 'Sickness' and 'Ancestral grave' run together with no line break in the image ('...dedications Ancestral grave: Average'); split into two items. en mixes curly (won’t) and straight (don't) apostrophes as printed.

zh.explain: 君王皇后都赐恩，再祈福做禳解则福德自会增长。一切众生都受到恩泽，天上人间都会万事亨通。
divination: 此签为上签。
上天给我们恩惠，一定不要忘记。
早晚皆应礼拜佛菩萨，并燃香、上供，以示诚意。
zh.summary: 此卦天垂恩泽之象。所祈求之事会功成名就，而且非常吉祥。

verse: Kindness bestowed by regal Kings and Queens,
Continual prayers bring more merits and blessings.
Shared with all these blessings you have received,
Everything would be smooth for you from Earth to Heaven.
interpretation: A favor from Heaven, one should never forget.
You should offer incense and pray day and night to demonstrate your gratitude.
meaning: Gifts and favors bestowed from heaven.
Everything will be successful and very auspicious.
en.explain: The King and Queen bestow blessings and if prayers continue, merits and blessings will grow.  All beings will be blessed, and everything will be prosperous in heaven and earth.
divination: This is an auspicious lot.
Never forget the blessings that heaven has bestowed us.  You should pay your respects to the Buddha and Bodhisattvas day and night, plus offer incense to show your sincerity.
items: Do good, pray for blessings & protection
Good luck at the end of the year

notes: zh key printed as 畜养动物; extra 迁徙搬家 item. Double spaces after periods in en explain/divination kept as printed.

zh.explain: 如天地一样善于相容、变通，就能拥有一切；通过自己的劳动自给自足，能确保自己一生平安。这样的人定然满目精彩，事事顺心，也应该真心感谢圣贤赐予生命的美好。
divination: 此签为上签。
天地万物其存亡之道都是相通的，明白了这个道理，就会福德相助，一切都充满了祥瑞之气。
zh.summary: 此卦天地交泰之象。所祈求之事皆大吉大利，没有危险。

verse: Heaven blends with Earth to create harmony in all lives,
Where all creatures thrive, grow and survive.
Marvel at the diversity and variety that is life.
Thank the deities and wise for all good things in your life.
interpretation: Just as Heavens give life to all, everything is connected.
Understand this and you will get both fortune and merits to help you in gaining peace and prosperity.
meaning: Heaven and Earth come together to bring peace and harmony.
(Everything is very auspicious with no threat of danger).
en.explain: If one can be as compatible  as heaven and earth, complementing each other, and flexible then one can possess everything. Supporting yourself through your own labor, you are more able to ensure a safe, peaceful life for yourself. Such a person will definitely live a life of diversity, with everything going well, which is even more reason to be grateful to the wise sages.
divination: This is an auspicious lot.
Heaven and earth, all living things are connected in their existence & survival. Once you understand this principle, you will get fortune and merits to make everything full of auspiciousness for you.
items: Do vast offerings for blessings and dedications
Auspicious if in the East or West

notes: zh jieyue last half-line read as 瑞气匆匆 as printed (the traditional text has 冲冲; the glyph looks like 匆). zh key printed as 畜养动物; extra 迁徙搬家 item. en explain has a double space in 'compatible  as' as printed.

zh.explain: 棋逢对手，实力相当，正处于难分胜负之时，而胜败常常只在一步棋，所以此时自己必须想出获胜的高招。
divination: 此签为中签。
心中所求的事，恰如下围棋一样，要想最后取得胜利，应该多用一些心机。
items: 多方思考规划才会顺利
zh.summary: 此卦棋逢敌手之象。所祈求之事宜多用心筹划，则吉祥稳当。

verse: Worthy opponents competing to win,
Undecided yet in the board of black and white.
A single move can decide the victorious,
Watch closely how your enemy steps and mind yours.
interpretation: Seeking what you want will be like playing a game of chess.  To win in the end, you should plan and strategize.
meaning: Two strong opponents set against each other, like a game between two chess masters.
Whatever you wish for, put more thoughts to plan.
(More thoughtful planning will be auspicious & smooth).
en.explain: When meeting one’s match in a chess game, it is difficult to determine who will emerge victorious.  Win or loss often depends on one move.  Therefore, you must think of a tactical move to win.
divination: This is a neutral lot.
Seeking what you wish is like playing a game of chess. To achieve that final victory, you need to use more effort to strategize.
items: Strategize carefully and you will succeed.
Use your wisdom to solve difficulties
Do good, pray for blessings & protection

notes: zh key printed as 畜养动物; extra 迁徙搬家 item. en 'Agriculture and commerce' value ends with a period as printed; curly apostrophe in 'one’s'; double spaces after periods kept.

zh.explain: 自古以来温柔都胜过刚强，多施善行的人家自会非常吉祥昌盛。抽到这个签的人，会像正渴时遇到琼浆一样，心意大顺。
divination: 此签为上签。
天地之间有感应，所以此签非常应验。得到神佛的护佑，更不能轻易忘。
items: 与人谦恭忍耐，自有贵人相助
zh.summary: 此卦积善温柔之象。所祈求之事有贵人相助则会十分和合。

verse: The gentle and kind will overcome the strong and violent.
Kind merits will be repaid with great prosperity for the family.
Whoever drew this Lot,
Your thirst will be quenched by precious wines.
interpretation: Heaven and Earth will be moved by piety.
Do not ever forget the benevolence and sympathy Heavens has shown you.
meaning: Tenderness and kindness will bring forth harmony and help from distinguished people.
en.explain: Since ancient times, gentleness has always won over force and violence. Those who do more good, are kind will naturally be very blessed and prosperous.  One who draws this lot is like encountering nectar when one is thirsty, and one’s mind will be peaceful.
divination: This is an auspicious lot.

Heaven and Earth will be moved, so your wishes will come true. Such blessings and protection given to you by the Buddha and gods must not be easily forgotten and all the more you should be grateful to them.
items: Will be profitable in later ½ of year
Be humble and patient with others, and will have own nobles to help you
Put in your best efforts will break through difficulties
Do good, pray for blessings & protection
Should face East or West to be propitious

notes: zh 学业考试 value ends with 。 as printed. zh key printed as 畜养动物; extra 迁徙搬家 item. en Lot Verse wraps mid-line ('...for the / family. Whoever drew this Lot,'); split at sentence/clause breaks. en uses the ½ character as printed.

zh.explain: 耐心持守原有的良好品质，不要产生过多的妄想。等待有人提携佐助，就会像枯树开花一样时来运转，也自然会兴旺发达。
divination: 此签为中签。
坚持原有的行事原则，事情自然能取得成功。
如果变来变去，则可能招致祸殃，反而是安静自处，没有灾难。
items: 不尽如人意，需加倍用功。
zh.summary: 此卦枯木生花之象。所祈求之事能顺应自然便会有好结果。

verse: Stay still and maintain your life as-is,
Steel your heart but create no evil.
Wait until help becomes available,
Flowers will bloom again in a withered tree.
interpretation: Keep things as they are.  Do not change anything and nothing will go wrong.  Things will eventually fall in place.  Any movement now may bring much misfortune.
meaning: A tree that had withered blossomed again.
Things will naturally fall in place.
en.explain: Be patient and keep your current good qualities, do not have too much wishful thinking. When someone brings you up, it is like a withered tree blossoming again, progress and prosperity will come naturally.
divination: This is a neutral lot.

Maintain the original ethical principles and things will naturally be well. If one keeps changing, it may bring misfortune. On the contrary, stay quiet and maintain things as status quo then there will be no misfortune.
items: Stick to duty and get better
Not as good as you want, you need to work harder.
Propitious, do good, pray for blessing and dedicate
Accumulate merits and pray for blessings

notes: Both pages list an extra item 迁徙搬家 / 'Migrating and moving house' (18 items vs 17 in lot 1). zh uses 畜养动物 (not 家养动物); en uses 'Traveller' (not 'Travel').

zh.explain: 能锦上添花则色彩会更加鲜艳，好运一来也自然会喜得俸禄骏马双全。不要抱怨功名来的太晚了.不管何时，只要一登高位就会四海扬名。
divination: 此签为上签。
坚守于现有的成就基础上，而开拓创新；等待好运的到来，可获得更大的成功，使得平生的志向得以实现，这一切其实也都是命中注定。
zh.summary: 此卦锦上添花之象。所祈求之事皆非常吉利。

verse: As flowers woven in to liven a silk brocade,
Luck arrives to bring you both rank and fortune.
Honor and fame can never be late in coming.
Topping an imperial exam to spread your name across the four seas.
interpretation: As you wait for the old to transit to the new, your time to succeed will come.  This is your life’s ambition and destiny.
meaning: Adding flowers to a silk brocade is to make what is already very good even better.  Everything will be extremely auspicious and favorable.
en.explain: To have embroidery weaved into a brocade will make it more vivid and brilliant.  When good luck comes, you will naturally be happy to have both rank and fortune.  Do not complain that honour and fame come too late.  Once you reach a high position, your reputation will spread far and wide.
divination: This is an auspicious lot.
If you add more innovations to your existing achievements, greater success will be achieved when good luck comes.  Your life’s ambitions will be realized. All these are in fact predestined.
items: Accumulate merits, pray for protection & blessings (Propitious)
Work hard towards your ambition will succeed
Be diligent and you will see results.
Accumulate merits and pray for blessings

notes: Extra item 迁徙搬家 / 'Migrating and moving house' on both pages. zh explain contains a half-width period after 太晚了 ('太晚了.不管何时') as printed. Double spaces after periods in en kept as printed.

zh.explain: 像鹍鸟在秋季转化变成大鹏，快乐地在天空中遨游。青云直上，出类拔萃，其余的飞禽都赶不上。
divination: 此签为中签。
只有鹍这种鸟能化为大鹏，其他的飞禽都不能。
到时攀折桂枝，登上高位，自然会增禄增福。
zh.summary: 此卦鹍鹏兴变之象。所祈求之事有所变动则会非常吉祥。

verse: Come Autumn, the partridge will transform into a Roc.
With great joy and cheer, it flies up.
Soaring high and higher among the clouds,
Beyond the reach of many other fowls.
interpretation: A partridge is transformed into a Roc – something not for every bird.  Pluck a branch from the heavenly tree and your wealth and fortune will multiply on their own.
meaning: A partridge is transformed into a Roc.  A dramatic change will bring great fortune.
en.explain: In autumn, a partridge is transformed into a large Roc, soaring joyfully in the air, straight up the sky, excelling, which the other birds could not catch up with.
divination: This is a neutral lot.
Only a partridge can transform into a Roc but no other birds can. When the time comes to ascend to a high position, wealth and blessings will keep on growing naturally.
items: Accumulate merits, pray for protection & blessings

notes: Extra item 迁徙搬家 / 'Migrating and moving house'. zh item 家宅情况 is followed by a semicolon-like mark (；) instead of ：on the page; normalized as key/value. 鹍 read from image (bird radical; standard form of this poem). zh 投资理财 says 秋天 (autumn) but en says 'Favorable in Spring' — copied as printed.

zh.explain: 处在天寒地冻，滴水成冰的困境中，何必贪婪吝啬于求取功名？只宜安分守己地在静处端坐，等待好运来时自然才会前景光明。
divination: 此签为中签。
水可以结成冰，冰也可融化为水。如果要营谋，其结果也是如此。
items: 成绩不甚理想，宜多培福
zh.summary: 此卦水结成冰之象。所祈求之事没必要枉费精力去求取。

verse: The winter’s cold freezes the water to ice.
Why hanker after fame and glory?
Best to remain and contemplate quietly,
All will be clear when the leaves grow again.
interpretation: Cold water freezes to solid ice.  Ice melts into water.  The success of any plan or scheme is up to Heaven to decide.
meaning: Cold water turns into ice.  Do not attempt anything beyond your capability to have or do.
en.explain: Just like being stuck in a difficult situation where freezing winter turns dripping water into ice, why bother to seek fame? Best to wait quietly for good luck to come, then the future will be bright and naturally clear.
divination: This is a neutral lot.
Cold water freezes to ice and ice melts into water.  If you have a plan, the result will be as so.
items: Accumulate merits, pray for protection & blessings
Not suitable to seek fame aggressively
Accumulate more merits thru’ blessings if your results are not satisfactory

notes: Extra item 迁徙搬家 / 'Migrating and moving house'. Question mark after 功名 in zh explain read as full-width ？.

zh.explain: 你可以高挂船帆，在五湖四海自由航行。如果获得顺风相送，便能很快达到目的，收获满船财宝满心欢喜。
divination: 此签为中签。
逍遥自在，悠闲惬意，用不着劳心费力，即可获得财源滚滚。
一切都能欢欣甜美。
items: 与人和善、顺势而为则顺心如意
zh.summary: 此卦顺风撑船之象。所祈求之事皆顺利吉祥。

verse: Sail as you please, across the world’s lakes and oceans,
With sails hoisted high, the ship moves on.
A good wind will soon herald its arrival,
A ship’s hull fills with troves of treasures.
interpretation: A life of ease and comfort.  A lot of wealth will come to you even with minimum effort.  This is an enviable position.
meaning: A ship sailing with a favorable wind.
Everything will turn out well and be fortuitous.
en.explain: You can sail at ease to any part of the world in a high-hoisted sail. If wind conditions are favourable, you will reach your goal speedily and gain a ship full of treasures with great joy.
divination: This is a neutral lot.
Life is carefree and relax, you will get a lot of wealth without any effort, everything goes well and joyful for you.
items: Favorable in later half of year
Be kind and go with the flow, you will have what you wish.
Give full play to your strengths and you will have good results

notes: Extra item 迁徙搬家 / 'Migrating and moving house'. zh 祖坟牌位 says 向南方位 (south) but en says 'Favorable if in the West' — copied as printed.

zh.explain: 夏季日长，炎炎闷热难以忍受，人人都很愁苦。天地也是善解人意的，也会不时送来拂拂和风，让人感到清凉。
divination: 此签为上签。
是进是退不要犹豫不决，时机已经悄然到来。
但计谋也不要过度，更不要轻举妄为。
items: 冷静分析优劣势，谨慎行事。
循次渐进地学习，不宜急躁
zh.summary: 此卦人人愁热之象。所祈求之事会顺心如愿。

verse: The summer days are long and hot,
The intense heat many fret over.
Heaven and Earth know too of human’s desires,
And so a naturally cooling southerly wind is sent.
interpretation: Do not hesitate to proceed.  The time for schemes and plans to take place has come, but do act modestly and not recklessly.
meaning: Everyone is affected by the heat in Autumn.
Your pursuits will turn out the way you desire.
en.explain: Summer days are long, and the scorching heat is unbearable and everyone feels distressed. Heaven and Earth are compassionate and frequently send gentle caressing breeze to help us feel cool and refreshing.
divination: This is an auspicious lot.
One should not hesitate to advance or retreat as the opportunity has arrived quietly. However, one must not move with haste and recklessness or go overboard in the planning.
items: Do good, pray for blessings & protection
Calmly analyze the advantages and disadvantages and act cautiously.
Learn step by step, don’t be impatient
Redeem a wish as repayment of gratitude

notes: Extra item 迁徙搬家 / 'Migrating and moving house'. zh key is 畜养动物状况 (longer than usual) on this page. en meaning says 'heat in Autumn' although the verse is about summer — copied as printed.

zh.explain: 水中捞月，费尽工夫也没有实际效果。不要胡言乱语说是说非，那样不仅枉费心思，还会使自己孤立。
divination: 此签为中签。
说出的话没有正常的逻辑关系，胡言乱语，费力劳心。
家中还有忧愁烦恼的事，需要有贵人相助才能解决。
items: 多观察思考并向人请教，不贸然行动。
专注课业，多请教，不要胡思乱想。
zh.summary: 此卦贪求费力之象。所祈求之事虽劳心费力，却徒劳无功。

verse: Fishing the moon out of waters,
All that efforts for nothing that matters.
Refrain from idle talk and false rumors,
That exhausts the soul and makes the isolation stronger.
interpretation: Empty words are meaningless, they waste efforts and exhaust your mind.  There is sorrow and worry in your household, wait for the arrival of your distinguished patron.
meaning: Futile attempts to satisfy one’s greed,
your endeavors and efforts will come to naught.
en.explain: It will be in vain and a waste of effort to scoop the moon out of the water. You should refrain from talking nonsense or gossiping, as this is of no avail, and also find yourself being isolated by others.
divination: This is a neutral lot.
There is no logic in your words, meaningless talk  and a waste of effort. Also, there are troubles at home. You need help from a distinguished person to solve your problems and worries.
items: Observe, think more and ask for advice, and don't act rashly.
Focus on your class work, ask for advice, and don't think outside unnecessary.
Accumulate merits, pray for protection & blessings
Accumulate merits, pray for protection & blessings

notes: Extra item 迁徙搬家 / 'Migrating and moving house'. en divination has a double space in 'meaningless talk  and' as printed. Apostrophes: 'don't' appears straight and 'Can’t' curly on the page (best reading).

zh.explain: 由失意变为得意时，像龙吟虎啸一样，高歌腾跃都适宜。蓝天之下自然有直通云霄之路，得到功名也只是早晚的事。
divination: 此签为中签。
得此签者，让去就去，叫停就停。行动举止遵循对方的意愿，自然通达顺畅，到头来也必定会有好的结果。
items: 勇敢面对困境，危机就是转机。
zh.summary: 此卦龙吟虎啸之象。所祈求之事能顺从自己的意愿而有望成功。

verse: When disappointment turns to joy,
The dragon’s song will blend with the tiger’s roar.
A thoroughfare cuts through the clear blue sky,
It’s time for one to gather fame once more.
interpretation: Let go of what needs to go, keep what needs to be kept.  Follow what is destined, you will understand and assimilate for your own use to pave your own path to success.
meaning: When the dragon calls or the tiger roars, there is hope that things will proceed as planned.
en.explain: When frustration turns into success, it is appropriate to sing and dance out heartily, just like a tiger roars and a dragon exalts in triumph. Under the blue sky, there is naturally a direct way up to it, so it is just a matter of time before you achieve fame.
divination: This is a neutral lot.
You will have a clear and smooth prospect when you follow the given instructions closely, let go of what needs to go, stop when told to stop, go with the flow. Eventually there will be good results.
items: Face a difficult situation bravely, a crisis becomes a turning point.
Continue to work hard, it will become a great weapon.
Accumulate merits, pray for protection & blessings

notes: Extra item 迁徙搬家 / 'Migrating and moving house'. Poem has 通霄路 as printed (shiyi/explain use 云霄). en interpretation line 1 (sentence break) kept within one string; 'Sickness:  Safe' has a double space after the colon on the page (trimmed in value). '50 %' spacing kept as printed.

zh.explain: 梦中得宝醒来却一场空，自以为长寿，实则是自损。如果询问的是婚姻、疾病方面的事情，最好另找门路寻求帮助。
divination: 此签为下签。
得此签者，就像东西掉入水中，从每个人的角度去看，其长短自然各不相同。人人都有各自的定分，这是不容易改变的。
items: 到达目的地的时间延迟
zh.summary: 此卦梦中得宝之象。所祈求之事枉费心力而徒劳无功。

verse: Treasures in the dream, gone when one is sober.
Just like an illusory joy of the man in the Nanke dream who woke up to delusion.
As for marriage & health, best look elsewhere for support and help.
interpretation: Images of things in the water are distorted, and they are of different dimensions.  All is preordained, you can neither discuss nor negotiate with Heavens.
meaning: Just like treasures in a dream, efforts will be in vain.
en.explain: Treasure in a dream is but an empty illusion when one wakes up. One is harming oneself when one thinks one has a long life. If the question is about marriage and illness,  it is best to find solutions elsewhere.
divination: This is an inauspicious lot.

Like images of things in water, the dimensions are distorted, everyone views things from their respective angles with different results. Everyone has his very own predestination, which cannot be altered easily.
items: You should be down- to-earth in doing your duty
Accumulate merits, pray for protection & blessings

notes: Extra item 迁徙搬家 / 'Migrating and moving house'. zh 自身情况 is followed by a semicolon-like mark (；) instead of ： on the page. en verse is printed as 3 sentences wrapped over 4 lines (not 4 verse lines); split at sentence breaks. en explain has double space in 'illness,  it' and Career value has 'down- to-earth' as printed.

zh.explain: 贤能代代相传，都过着丰衣足食的生活，这都是天的护佑。父母安康全家欢乐，饿了吃，渴了喝，困倦就睡。
divination: 此签为中签。
就像用竹节引泉水一样，一节接一节，连续不断。贤能的人会筹谋未来。
因此，无不有令人欣喜欢悦的结果。
items: 记得兑现曾对菩萨许下的承诺
zh.summary: 此卦接竹引泉之象。所祈求之事若能想得更远则大吉大利。

verse: A virtuous father will teach his descendants virtues.
Heaven will provide plenty for their wants and needs.
The elders in the family are happy and fulfilled.
Hunger is filled, thirst is quenched, the tired may rest,
interpretation: Like bamboo poles arranged to connect to a spring, this will survive generations.  Whatever an upright man pursues, it will be filled with great joy and happiness.
meaning: Stack the bamboo to lead towards a stream.
What you aspire will be fortuitously achieved.
en.explain: It is the blessing from Heaven that a virtuous father can pass on his virtues to descendants with generations all living a life of abundance. Parents are healthy, the family is happy, with sufficient food to eat, drink and can rest when tired.
divination: This is a neutral lot.
It is like drawing water from spring by joining sections of bamboo together.  The able man knows to plan for his future.  Hence the ending is always filled with joy and happiness.
items: Remember to repay your vows made to Bodhisattvas
You will receive help from benefactors
Do vast offerings for blessings and dedications

notes: Extra item 迁徙搬家 / 'Migrating and moving house'. en verse last line ends with a comma (not a period) as printed. zh explain starts '贤能代代相传' as printed.

zh.explain: 乘一叶小舟悠游在小溪浅滩间，山林中风清月明，花草飘香。若问前路何去何从，不如享受着山林乐趣，等贵人出现。
divination: 此签为中签。
谋划改变当前的现状，并去实施，是费力劳心的事情。
保持现状，等待时机再作打算，才可能大吉大利。
zh.summary: 此封船行小滩之象。所祈求之事将获得贵人的协助。

verse: Running water sounds on stones at the shallows of streams,
Disturb not the wise on a cool, clear moonlit night.
Need seek guidance on which path to go,
But not be distracted by the scent and sight of flowers.
interpretation: Efforts spent in organizing your plans to achieve a goal will be wasted.  You should let things remain for now and wait for a time when things would augur well.
meaning: Riding a small boat along a stream, you will have benefactors to help you through.
en.explain: Row a boat leisurely in between streams and shoals, enjoy the clear breeze, the bright moon and the fragrance of flowers in the mountain. If you wish to ask which path to go in life, it is better to relax, enjoy the beauty of the mountain and its flora,  and wait for guidance from a benefactor.
divination: This is a neutral lot.

It is extremely tiring, both mentally and physically to plan and implement changes to the present situation. It is better to keep the status quo, wait for the right time to plan then everything can be auspicious.

notes: Extra item 迁徙搬家 / 'Migrating and moving house'. zh shiyi and summary print 此封 (apparent typo for 此卦) — copied as printed. en verse is wrapped mid-line on the page; split at the capitalized clause starts. en explain has double space in 'flora,  and'; 'Sickness:  Will' double space trimmed in value.

zh.explain: 听到是非之言就当做耳边风，这样自然会有富裕丰足的生活。莫再记着当年的旧事了。
divination: 此签为中签。
对未来所作的谋划能够获得完满的结果。
做事恳切，以公为先，就像孩子遇到母亲般，将会获得依靠与协助。
zh.summary: 此卦孩儿见母之象。所祈求之事逢贵人相助则会大吉大利。

verse: Let rumors or scandals whisk past your ears like winds,
For a life of fine clothes and plenty is yours to have.
Unshackle your past and let bygones be bygones,
On this, I am certain you will surely agree.
interpretation: What you are planning will bring much success and joy to yourself and others.
Work for the good of the public with a devotion like a mother to her child.
meaning: Like when the child sees the mother, you will have support from others, your pursuits will go well.
en.explain: Turn a deaf ear to gossip and rumours, you will naturally gain happiness and abundance in your life. Avoid dwelling on the past.
divination: This is a neutral lot.
You will be able to realize your future plans. Do things sincerely, put the public first, serve them like the devotion of a mother to her child and you will find refuge and support.
items: Not safe, do more good and pray for blessings
Do good, pray for blessings & protection

notes: zh items include extra 迁徙搬家 row (not in lot 1) and key 畜养动物 (lot 1: 家养动物); en has matching 'Migrating and moving house' row and key 'Traveller'.

zh.explain: 须牢记，要说直话，莫在外地从事别的职业，一定要守本分操旧业。除此之外，干什么职业都不吉利。
divination: 此签为中签。
能够停下就停下，能有所得就该安定下来，不要再强求其他任何的东西。
只要保持住现状就可以。
zh.summary: 此卦守旧待时之象。所祈求之事宜保持现状，则会吉祥。

verse: A straight counsel you must bear in mind,
Do not pursue other trades in foreign soil.
Maintain your lot, practice what was your trade,
For anything else will have no place.
interpretation: You should stop when you need to.
Be content with your lot, there is no better position to occupy.
Let things remain as-is and do not concern yourself with other matters.
meaning: Stay where you are and wait.
Your patience will be well rewarded in time to come.
en.explain: Bear in mind to speak honestly and plainly. Refrain from taking up other jobs or businesses in a foreign land and keep dutifully to your original trade. There should be no other trades better than this.
divination: This is a neutral lot.
If possible, stop for a while, settle down and be content with your lot.  Do not insist on anything more, just remain status quo.
items: Listen to the advice of the elders
Lack safety, need to take care of health

notes: zh: 官司诉讼 is followed by a full-width semicolon (；) instead of colon in the image; key normalized. Sickness key printed as 疾病情况 (not 治病健康). Extra 迁徙搬家 row; key 畜养动物. en divination has double space after 'lot.' as printed; key 'Traveller'.

zh.explain: 想上高楼深院去躲避灾难，四周的荆棘却仍然如同丛林。若要向他人求助，也应选好对象，切不可再陷入得一失二之境。
divination: 此签为中签。
在是非不明之时，应该像喝醉了还要饮酒一样装糊涂。
宜保持现状，只等待时来运转，这样才能无灾无祸。
zh.summary: 此卦守旧随时之象。所祈求之事需等待时机的到来，才会有好结果。

verse: High up in the tower one hides away,
Surrounded by a forest of thorns and thistles.
Fate decrees the long and short of life,
You may lose more than what you gain.
interpretation: Like a drunken man (who is not sober), it is better to lie still and wait for the right time in order to avoid any disaster or be blamed for anything.
meaning: Stay put and wait for a time when things will be more auspicious.
en.explain: Want to climb up a tower or go into a deep courtyard to avoid a disaster but the surrounding is full of obstacles and thorns like in a jungle. If you wish to seek assistance, ensure you pick the right person to avoid being in a losing state.
divination: This is a neutral lot.

When things are unclear, it is best to pretend to be confused like a drunkard, and maintain the status quo. Wait for the right time, till a turn of fortune comes then you will be able to avoid disasters and accidents.
items: Do good, pray for blessings & protection
Do good, pray for blessings & protection
Do good, pray for blessings & protection

notes: Extra 迁徙搬家 / 'Migrating and moving house' row; zh key 畜养动物; en key 'Traveller'.

zh.explain: 抱柴草去救火，会燃得更旺，甚至会无止尽地燃烧。如果要问荣华富贵和出入是否平安，不如收起自己的枉然心机。
divination: 此签为下签。
即使有很多好的选择，也不如保持现状，否则一旦变化，恐怕要惹祸上身。
zh.summary: 此卦抱薪救火之象。所祈求之事还需自己小心谨慎防护。

verse: Add fuel to a fire and now it burns more fiercely,
The bright flames spread for miles, sparing nothing.
On the pursuits of riches and fame,
Why not save the trouble and forget?
interpretation: Why bother with so many schemes, why not let things remain?
Doing too much may someday inevitably create problems that will be hard to get rid of.
meaning: Trying to extinguish a fire with firewood.
You must take precautions to protect yourself.
en.explain: When you carry firewood to put out a fire, it will burn more fiercely, and even burn endlessly. If you are asking about wealth, fame and safe passage wherever you go, you might as well put away your scheming efforts.
divination: This is an inauspicious lot.
Even if you have many good choices, it is better to maintain the status quo.
Otherwise, you may get into trouble once changes occur.

notes: Extra 迁徙搬家 / 'Migrating and moving house' row; zh key 畜养动物; en key 'Traveller'. en divination: 'Otherwise...' starts on a new line in the image, kept as separate entry.

zh.explain: 日落月生的空闲时吟诗唱歌，只图一时玩乐高兴。既然难以回避人群，不如大家一同喝彩，齐唱夫妻恩爱的民谣小调。
divination: 此签为中签。
有佳人在屋里吟诗唱曲，心情自然十分欢畅。
这样的生活是福还是祸，也不必在意，因为一切都命中注定。
zh.summary: 此卦守旧随时之象。所祈求之事遇到好时机就会顺利实现。

verse: Recite poems in the days, sing songs at nights,
Enjoy the fun and laughter in such gatherings.
Such merry-making is rare and hard to hide,
So sing to our hearts’ content as a cordial couple will like.
interpretation: A joyous scene where a beautiful woman entertains with songs and verses.
One’s fortunes and misfortunes are preordained.
meaning: Let things stay status quo and wait for the right occasion.
Things will be auspicious when the time is right.
en.explain: When the night falls, recite poems and sing at leisure, just to seek an uproarious moment. When it is difficult to avoid others, it is better for everyone to applaud and sing together folk songs of the love of husband and wife.
divination: This is a neutral lot.

When there are beautiful people at home singing poetry, the mood naturally  is very joyful. But there is no need to care whether such a life is a blessing or curse because all things are decreed by destiny.
items: Good to keep to the present
Will make a full recovery soon

notes: zh animal key printed as 动物状况 (not 家养/畜养动物). Extra 迁徙搬家 / 'Migrating and moving house' row; en key 'Traveller'. zh shiyi '此卦守旧随时之象' identical to lot 59, as printed. en divination double space in 'naturally  is' and curly apostrophes kept as printed.

zh.explain: 时时刻刻得到佛祖庇佑，即使遇到危险也不会产生严重后果。如果再得到贵人提携，财富必定会随之而来。
divination: 此签为中签。
平平稳稳，而且名扬四方。
即使改变原有状况，开始新的人生，也不会有什么风险。
items: 得贵人相助而化险为夷
zh.summary: 此卦神佛暗佑之象。所祈求之事须暗自忍耐才会吉祥。

verse: Chants the words of Buddha mornings and evenings,
With his support we may meet dangers but will avert all.
Guidance and support from a distinguished patron,
Will bring you wealth and gold as well.
interpretation: A steady and stable situation.
Your name is known in all four directions.
There is little danger even if you do change the old for the new.
meaning: Unseen divine protection.
You need not worry about anything but wait and good fortune will come.
en.explain: With the protection of the Buddha at all times, you would not be severely hurt, even if you encounter danger.  Additionally, if you have the help of a patron, wealth and abundance will definitely follow.
divination: This is a neutral lot.
Steady and well-known, even if you change the original situation and start a new life, there will be no risk.
items: Turn dangers into safety, there are benefactors to help
Put in hard work to succeed
Do good, pray for blessings & protection
Do good, pray for blessings & protection

notes: zh keys as printed: 官司情况 (not 官司诉讼), 疾病情况 (not 治病健康), 畜养动物; extra 迁徙搬家 / 'Migrating and moving house' row; en key 'Traveller'. en explain keeps printed double space after 'danger.'.

zh.explain: 从前在船上丢失了针，现在到海里去寻找。即使找到从前那根针，也是枉费心力和时间。
divination: 此签为中签。
福分是财禄的基础，财禄是福分的种子，二者相辅相成。
既然已经清楚分明，那么就应该谨慎处理。
zh.summary: 此卦海中寻针之象。所祈求之事还需费心劳力。

verse: A needle lost when we were last at sea,
Now searching for it, we continue at sea.
A waste of efforts and labor,
Even if we do find the needle.
interpretation: Fortune is based on wealth as wealth is built on fortune.
Know this and proceed with caution.
meaning: Searching for a needle in the vast ocean.
A futile and laborious effort.
en.explain: You lost a needle on a ship before and now you are still searching for it in the sea. Even if the old needle is found, it is a waste of effort and time.
divination: This is a neutral lot.
Blessing is the foundation for wealth and wealth is the seed for blessing. They complement each other. Since these two are already clear and distinct, they should be handled with caution.
items: Sincerely seek blessings from Triple Gems

notes: Extra 迁徙搬家 / 'Migrating and moving house' row; zh key 畜养动物; en key 'Traveller'. 适宜迁徙 verified by zoom (徙, not 徒).

zh.explain: 像鱼正在碧波池中畅游，却遭到罗网四面投来。费尽心机，无计脱身，始终陷身于是非灾祸之中。
divination: 此签为下签。
在屋中安身而坐，也有灾祸从天而降。
要提早觉察，先作防范，才能免遭祸殃。
zh.summary: 此卦鱼遭罗网之象。所祈求之事应当小心提防。

verse: A fish swimming in a clear blue pond,
Hits upon a net that has it surrounded.
Clueless as it tries desperately to escape,
Yet all is in vain in the end.
interpretation: A roof provides shelter but calamity may still fall on you.
Be aware and take precautions and you may be spared the disaster.
meaning: A fish caught in the net.
It is better to take precautions.
en.explain: Like a fish swimming in a clear blue pond, yet it is trapped by a net cast from all sides.  Exhausted and nowhere to escape, it is always trapped in the middle of disaster.
divination: This is an inauspicious lot.
Though a roof gives you shelter, yet disasters may still fall on you.  It is best to be aware of them in advance and take precautions, then you can avoid disasters.
items: Humility and forbearance should be practised.
Should be treated as soon as possible

notes: Extra 迁徙搬家 / 'Migrating and moving house' row; zh key 畜养动物; en key 'Traveller'. en 'Birth' sits at the bottom of the left column in the image (not top of right); order kept in reading sequence. Printed double spaces after sentences kept in en explain/divination.

zh.explain: 眼前的欢喜并非真正的欢喜，虽无危险，但也不可能安宁。为什么要做割肉补疮的事呢？还不如因循守旧等待时机。
divination: 此签为下签。
该止则止，能宽则宽，无论割自身哪一处的肉，引起的疼痛也是一样的。
zh.summary: 此卦割肉补疮之象。所祈求之事只宜安于现状，等待时机。

verse: What you see as happy before may not be so,
Neither danger nor safety will it be.
Cutting one’s own flesh to patch one’s injury is dumb,
Better to remain and wait for the time.
interpretation: An intelligent man knows when to stop, when to proceed.
Cutting one’s flesh only brings more pain and little relief.
meaning: A foolish man cuts his own flesh to patch his injury, inflicting more injuries on himself.
One should maintain status quo and wait for the right time.
en.explain: The joy at hand is not genuine, although there is no danger, it does not mean that you get peace. Why do you cut your flesh to patch a sore? A wiser course is to make no change and wait for the right opportunity.
divination: This is an inauspicious lot.
A man of prudence knows when to stop and when to forgive. No matter which part of the body you cut, the pain inflicted is still the same.
items: There is a scare but not danger
Tolerance by both union can last long

notes: zh keys as printed: 官司情况, 疾病情况, 畜养动物; extra 迁徙搬家 / 'Migrating and moving house' row; en key 'Traveller'; en 'Birth' is last in left column. Curly apostrophes kept as printed.

zh.explain: 道路险峻，马又疲弱乏力，却必须催马疾行，不然就会落伍，就像失散的败兵一样。急流脸滩，浪高风危，船又破，桨又折了，就像花凋残了又遇霜冻一样。
divination: 此签为下签。
保持现状，等待时机，安静而不妄动，则不会有大过失。
也不用费心谋划，只能顺其自然，自在悠游。
zh.summary: 此卦船破下滩之象。所祈求之事或有危险及阻碍，应小心提防。

verse: An anxious rider pushing a horse on a steep road,
Trouble they will have if they fall away from the troop.
As a boat caught in stormy seas with broken oars,
The days are darker, the flowers have withered and snow begins to fall.
interpretation: Let things remain and wait.
Few can find fault when one stays quiet.
Stay carefree and free.
Do not scheme or plot.
meaning: A boat was wrecked as it tried to navigate the rapids.
The situation is precarious, you must stay alert and take precautions.
en.explain: The road is treacherous, the horses are weak and  exhausted but the riders must push their horses to move quickly or they will lag behind and become like lost, defeated soldiers. Like a rickety ship with broken oars, that sweeps through rapids against high waves and strong winds, resembles withered flowers in the frost.
divination: This is an inauspicious lot.

Keep things unchanged, wait for opportunity, stay quiet and do not act rashly,  then there will be no big losses.  Don’t bother yourself with plots and schemes, just let things take its natural course and you can stay carefree.
items: Unstable, advisable to manage with care
Do vast offerings for blessings and dedications quickly.
Accumulate more merits, & pray for blessings

notes: Both pages have NO 寻失物 / 'Missing things' row (17 items). zh explain prints 急流脸滩 (likely typo for 险滩) - kept as printed, verified by zoom. zh animal key 动物状况; extra 迁徙搬家 / 'Migrating and moving house' row; en key 'Traveller'. en double spaces ('weak and  exhausted', 'rashly,  then', 'losses.  Don’t') and mixed straight/curly apostrophes kept as printed.

zh.explain: 一条金绳给你指明正道，开启智慧，使你达到增之不重，减之不轻的完美境界。一生为人正直，事业文章都具有很高水平和价值。
divination: 此签为上签。
心性正直，心态平和，那么其人生境遇则清清爽爽，平平安安。
如果每个人都能安守本份生活，则天下就太平了。
items: 按部就班地学习会有好成绩
zh.summary: 此封心平正直之象。所祈求之事会平安稳定，没有凶险。

verse: A golden thread measures your heart,
No more, no less, the heart is balanced.
Be steadfast, just and upright all your life.
Your compositions are filled with treasures and light.
interpretation: Calm and upright, your things are ultimately kept in good order.
If everyone fulfills their duties well, the world will be at peace.
meaning: A steadfast, calm and upright person.
Such an attitude negates all that could be ominous.
en.explain: A golden rope will point you to the right path, ignite your wisdom and help you attain a perfect state of balance in life. You have been upright, righteous all your life, with an esteemed career and high quality articles to boot.
divination: This is an auspicious lot.

By upholding righteousness and with an amicable nature, you will be able to cruise through any circumstance with ease and peace. If everyone can live by their duty, there will be peace and harmony in the world.
items: Studying in a step-by-step manner will lead to good grades
Do vast offerings for blessings and dedications

notes: zh shiyi and summary print 此封 (typo for 此卦), verified by zoom, kept as printed. zh divination has 本份 as printed. Extra 迁徙搬家 / 'Migrating and moving house' row; zh key 畜养动物; en key 'Traveller'; en 'Birth' is last in left column.

zh.explain: 家中延纳喜庆，欢喜异常。多施善行，定会大吉利、大昌盛。婚姻、耕种诸事顺遂，即使生病也会遇到良医，很快就会转为安康。
divination: 此签为中签。
施行善举的家族，一定有很多值得庆贺的喜事；
尽忠尽义的人家，也必定福星高照。
zh.summary: 此庭门吉庆之象。所祈求之事能顺利及如愿的成办。

verse: A great joyous celebration at the gate,
Auspices and great fortune for the kind and generous.
Marriage, farming, everything will be as desired,
And the sick will recover with miracles.
interpretation: A family who performs good deeds will accumulate good fortune.
Descendants of the loyal will be blessed.
meaning: Happy celebrations at one’s gate,
everything is going well.
en.explain: When the family has celebrations, the joy is exceptional. Practise generosity and doing more virtuous deeds will certainly bring great blessings and prosperity to the family, marriage, farming and all other matters will be smoothly accomplished. Even the sick will meet good doctors and recover very quickly.
divination: This is a neutral lot.
A family who performs acts of kindness and generosity will definitely have many happy occasions for celebration; a honest and righteous family will be blessed with good fortune.
items: Follow your heart & all will be done as wished

zh.explain: 即使成了寒冬的梅树，虽然叶落枝空也终究不会被摧毁。只要春的气息悄悄到来，依旧会成为花中魁首。
divination: 此签为中签。
一箭射向空中，其实并不是漫无目标。
梅花待到春天到来时，也会在五彩缤纷中放出光彩。
items: 到达目的地的时间会延迟
zh.summary: 此卦梅花占魁之象。所祈求之事应推迟进行，才会吉利。

verse: A plum tree on a hill on a winter’s day.
Its leaves have fallen, its twigs have withered, yet it stands.
When the warmth of Spring quietly returns,
Its floral majesty would once again be restored.
interpretation: An arrow is released but misses its target.
All is not lost, when Spring is here again, your reward will be amongst what it brings.
meaning: The plum tree blooms in full majesty.
Things may take a while to come to fruition but it will bode well.
en.explain: Even if it becomes a plum tree in the cold winter, its leaves have fallen and its branches are bare, yet it remains standing. When the warmth of spring creeps in, the plum tree’s floral majesty will again be restored.
divination: This is a neutral lot.
An arrow is shot in the air but is not without a target. With the arrival of spring, the plum tree will radiate with splendour amid the profusion of spring colours.
items: You should treasure your study time

notes: zh poem line 3 reads 悄急至 as printed. zh uses 畜养动物. en uses 'Traveller'.

zh.explain: 天天都像采花的蜜蜂，东西南北奔波忙碌。春尽花残无处采花了，却依旧在奔波忙碌。
divination: 此签为下签。
没有了春天的景色，天气也久雨不晴，命如蜜峰的人哪有什么收获呢？
这种情况下费心谋事，还不如安心静养，等待时机。
items: 小心对方会反复不定、出尔反尔
zh.summary: 此卦蜜蜂采花之象。所祈求之事还需劳心费力。

verse: Working day after day like a busy bee,
Flying everywhere from flower to flower.
Nowhere to go when Spring ends with the flowers gone,
The heart remains and your steps the same.
interpretation: As the colors of Spring fade, the rain begins to fall in torrents.
It’s better to withdraw and lead a quiet existence than to scheme and plan with vigor.
meaning: Like a busy bee,
you need to labor hard to earn your living.
en.explain: Like the busy bees that fly from flower to flower, each day, busy gathering honey from east to west, north to south. Even when spring is gone and the flowers have faded, they are still busy rushing about.
divination: This is an inauspicious lot.

Without the colours of spring and the rain falling unceasingly, what can a man whose life is busy as a bee gain anything? Under such a circumstance, instead of wasting your effort to plot and scheme, it is better to lead a quiet life, and wait for the opportunity.
items: Be careful that the other party will be inconsistent and go back on his words.
It's takes a lot of effort but it can't be done
Have to work hard and should not move
Obstruction, need to pray more for blessings

notes: Extra item 迁徙搬家 / 'Migrating and moving house' on both pages (18 items). zh divination prints 蜜峰 (typo for 蜜蜂), kept as printed. en 'It's takes' typo kept. en uses 'Traveller'.

zh.explain: 谁有把提像苍龙马一样在四通八达的路上奔驰。一个女人嫁了两个丈夫，从此像一张弓架两支箭，努力使各方和平相处，方能稳定。
divination: 此签为中签。
如果出不了重重大门紧闭的环境，就应该当听天由命。
一旦冲出了这个桎梏自己的牢笼，就要谨慎从事。
zh.summary: 此卦一弓架两箭之象。所祈求之事需第二次作为，待因缘和合才会吉利。

verse: Ride like a swift horse smoothly though all roads.
Like a woman married to two husbands,
As a bow fitted with two arrows,
One must work to place all sides at peace.
interpretation: Regardless of the obstacles you faced, things are predestined, be bold and draw your bow, you will hit the mark, you should still however be on your guard.
meaning: A single bow fitted with two arrows.
There must be agreement in order for things to turn out well.
（What is sought needs to be done a second time to be auspicious.）
en.explain: Who can ride so swiftly in all directions like a dragon and horse. A woman who marries two husbands is like a single bow fitted with two arrows. Only by working hard to make all parties live in peace and harmony can stability be achieved.
divination: This is a neutral lot.

If you cannot get out of your obstacle-filled environment where the doors are tightly closed, you should just accept your fate. Once you break out of the cage that imprisons you, you must proceed with caution.
items: It will be a lot of work & effort
Everything comes to him who waits.
Diligence can make up for one's weaknesses, keep working hard.
Do vast offerings for blessings and dedications

shiyi: 此卦结蜂采蜜、求甜得苦之象。
诸事劳心费力，凡事防范灾殃也。
zh.explain: 养峰当然想得到峰蜜，只是恐怕会被蜂尾针螫。虽然目前有别的路可走，但暗里仍然荆棘密布。
divination: 此签为中签。
做事必须仔细，不要强求，如同与蜜蜂结伴去采蜜一样，哪会有什么好结果啊?
items: 到达目的地的时间延迟
zh.summary: 此卦结蜂采蜜、求甜得苦之象。所祈求之事不仅劳心费力，还需防范祸殃。

verse: Raise bees for the sake of their honey,
The only fear are the stings from the tails.
Although there are other ways to make a living,
There are hidden thistles and thorns that one does not see.
interpretation: Plans need to be thought through.
Do not ask for the sky.
Raise the bees for honey and there will be rewards for your labor.
meaning: Gathering bees in order to collect honey, a bitter effort to collect some sweetness.
A lot of hard work and effort is required.
Take precautions to avoid disasters.
en.explain: We raise bees for their honey, only that we fear being stung by them. Although we have alternate paths currently, we know there are hidden thorns we do not see.
divination: This is a neutral lot.
When working we need to be meticulous and not ask for the sky. It is akin to raising bees for honey, what good will come out of it?
items: Work hard, will get through the hard times.
Do vast offerings for blessings & dedications

zh.explain: 春雷震响，冬眠的虫儿欢唱着从泥土中翻身而出，才感到自由来去的畅快。如果某天再发生质的变化，虫也会成
divination: 此签为上签。
春雷响起时开始发生转化，从此能出能入，轻松自如。
如果某天转化完成，必定能获得巨大成功。
zh.summary: 此卦雷发百虫之象。所祈求之事得遇贵人，有吉祥的征兆。

verse: Awaken by a sudden clap of thunder in Spring,
Worms and insects call and leap from the soil.
As the comings and goings gather together,
In one sweep, they are transformed into a dragon.
interpretation: As the thunder roars, the wheel of fortune turns.
In one quick sweep, things change and one is soon in front of the celestial gate.
meaning: The thunder woke all hibernating creatures.
Your affairs will be auspicious because of the help you will receive from others.
en.explain: The spring thunder rumbles, and the hibernating worms sing and roll over from the soil, then they can feel the liberty to come and go. If one day another qualitative change occurs, worms can even become dragons.
divination: This is an auspicious lot.
When the sudden thunder of spring awakens, fortune starts to change; from then on, you can get around with ease. When the day of change happens, one will definitely attain huge success.
items: Do good, pray for blessings & protection.
Have the opportunity to be promoted by distinguished persons
Should study hard and ask for advice.
Hard to recover, need to take good care.
