zh.explain: 像鸿鹄自己飞进樊笼，想再翻身飞出已很难办到。四面八方都没有出路，抽到这支签恐怕也会忧愁无穷。
divination: 此签为下签。
前进已不可能，后退也很困难。
一切都不管了，低头而去，成败都在其中。
items: 不宜换，转变也达不到好的结果
zh.summary: 此卦似鹄投笼之象。所祈求之事是虚假的成分多，真实的成分少。

verse: Like a snow goose that files blindly into a cage,
Tried as it may, it cannot be free.
North, South, East, West, all the ways are blocked.
This Lot foretells an endless regret.
interpretation: You may neither move forward nor move back.
Lie low and continue, successes and failures are pre-destined.
meaning: A huge swan plunges itself into the trap.
Many things are not what they seemed.
en.explain: Just like a swan that flies blindly into a cage, it is difficult to fly out again. There is no escape route in all directions. Hence, this lot foretells endless sorrow.
divination: This is an inauspicious lot.
Moving forward is impossible and moving backwards is very tough too. All is impossible so quietly accept that success or failure is predestined.
items: Keep a low profile and be cautious.
Mutually harmful, advisable to be cautious
Prevent dangers, take care of your health
Expect calamity, do more good & pray for blessings
Better not to change, no good end even if change
Pray for blessings soonese & do good

notes: Extra item 迁徙搬家 / 'Migrating and moving house' (18 items). zh keys 官司状况 and 疾病情况 copied as printed. en typos kept as printed: 'files blindly' (flies) in the verse, 'soonese' in Ancestral grave. en uses 'Traveller'.

zh.explain: 像抱着老虎爬高山，真是战战兢兢、胆破心寒。幸好在前方遇得高人相助，万事无虞，人也因此一生平安。
divination: 此签为中签。
危险就在眼前，胆战心惊，前程受阻。
如果要询问如何计谋策划，终究是很辛苦的事。
zh.summary: 此卦抱虎过山之象。所祈求之事会有凶险，而且令人惊恐。

verse: Like dragging a tiger up the mountains,
You tremble with fear as you steel your gall.
Luckily you meet an expert at the front of the mountain,
You survive safe and sound with a life to dwell.
interpretation: There are dangers and obstacles in your path.
You will need to labor hard if you want your plans to work.
meaning: Like a man carrying a tiger up the mountains,
there is fear and danger ahead.
en.explain: There is a feeling of fear and trepidation, like carrying a tiger to climb a mountain, frightening one to death. Fortunately, you meet an expert benefactor up front, so everything is safe and you can lead a safe life.
divination: This is a neutral lot.
Danger is ahead, tremble with fear, the future is perilous and full of obstacles. If your query is regarding planning and strategy, the answer is: it will be a very difficult process.
items: Accumulate merits, pray for protection & blessings
Unfavourable, pray to Triple Gems for blessing

notes: Extra item 迁徙搬家 / 'Migrating and moving house' (18 items). zh keys 官司状况 and 疾病情况 copied as printed. en uses 'Traveller'.

zh.explain: 鱼龙混杂，都想得到高升，所以最好是耐心待在深水里等待命运亨通。机缘到来时，会不知不觉一纵身就会跳过龙门。
divination: 此签为中签。
虽然有良好的根基，但也要静待时机。
在谋划和行动时要根据自己的实际情况，切不要胆大妄为。
items: 到达目的地的时间延迟
zh.summary: 此卦鱼龙未变之象。所祈求之事宜等待时机的到来，则可进行。

verse: A fish? A dragon? Looks different but they are the same,
Patiently they wait in deep waters for their luck to turn.
Suddenly one day, one rears its head
And in one leap, crosses the Dragon Gate.
interpretation: Even with a well-nourished foundation, one needs time to flourish.
Manage and plan your own affairs and do not be arrogant and reckless.
meaning: A fish has yet to transform into a dragon.
Everything will be in place if you only wait.
en.explain: Fish and dragons are mixed in a pond, all hoping to rise up, so it is best to be patient in the deep water and wait for your good fortune to come. When the right time comes, you will unknowingly cross the dragon gate in one leap. (i.e. gain success effortlessly).
divination: This is a neutral lot.

Although the foundations are strong, there is a need to wait patiently for the right timing. You must assess the actual situation before you decide to put your plans into action, do not be too bold and reckless.
items: Do not act rashly, it is advisable to be careful.
Make enough preparations well in advance
Will be favorable at year end
Protect future generations then will prosper.

notes: Both pages omit 寻失物 / 'Missing things' and include 迁徙搬家 / 'Migrating and moving house' (17 items). zh poem 头耸出 and jieyue 滋基 copied as printed. en uses 'Traveller'.

zh.explain: 财富虽多却在梦中，名声虽高并不真实。太遥远的东西难以确定其真实性，只有贵人指点后才能笑逐颜开。
divination: 此签为中签。
像在梦中说梦一样，不要期待什么声名。
若想有一个好的结果，应当让贵人给予指点和帮助。
items: 到达目的地的时间延迟
zh.summary: 此卦梦中得宝之象。所祈求之事是虚假的成分多，实在的成分少。

verse: Much wealth you have in your dreams,
What’s in a name but an empty word.
Things found beyond seas and mountains hard to be real,
Only help from a patron will put a smile on your face.
interpretation: Dreams are dreams, do not hanker after fame.
Wait for the right moment when your distinguished patron will guide you.
meaning: Treasures appear only in dreams;
many things are not what they appear to be.
en.explain: Although wealth is abundant it is present only in dreams. Although reputation is high, it is not real. It is very difficult to ascertain the authenticity of things far away, only guidance from a benefactor can put a smile on your face.
divination: This is a neutral lot.
Like talking in a dream, do not have too much expectation on fame.
If you wish to have a good outcome, you must be ready to accept guidance and assistance from a benefactor.
items: Do good, pray for blessings & protection
Not so smooth, work harder to do good, pray for blessings
Do vast offerings for blessings and dedications

notes: Extra item 迁徙搬家 / 'Migrating and moving house' (18 items). en uses 'Traveller'.

zh.explain: 冷水还没烧成开水，既不冷也不烫，还只是温凉的，不会有什么力道。而人要通畅地行走天下，全赖自身本领高强。
divination: 此签为上签。
犯案入狱会遇到大赦，生病了会得到良医救治。
要寻求财富和前程，则需得到贵人的指点。
zh.summary: 此封平善用事之象。所祈求之事平稳处理则会大吉大利。

verse: The cold water has yet to come to a steaming boil.
Neither cold nor hot, just cool enough.
To roam the world with success,
Strong skills you will need to have.
interpretation: A criminal obtains a general pardon.
The sick will meet a good physician.
Guidance from distinguished people will help you in your pursuits for wealth and success.
meaning: Go about your usual affairs with compassion,
everything will turn out steady and auspicious.
en.explain: Before the water is boiled, it is neither cold nor hot. It is just lukewarm. At this stage, the water is not too useful. For one to roam the world without hindrance, it all depends on one's strong skills and capabilities.
divination: This is an auspicious lot.
Prisoners will be pardoned and the sick will meet and be cured by a good doctor. To seek wealth and a better prospect, you will need guidance from benefactors.

notes: Extra item 迁徙搬家 / 'Migrating and moving house' (18 items). zh shiyi and summary print 此封 (typo for 此卦), kept. zh item 顺景如意 (for 顺境) kept as printed. en uses 'Traveller'.

zh.explain: 曾在虚空许愿求平安，保佑了平安却不还愿。不要忘了神灵应该还愿，更要知道不能随便忽视当初的誓言。
divination: 此签为中签。
别人拥有的东西，见到了后自己不要急于也想得到。
观音菩萨的指示，切不要怠慢而不把它放在心上。
zh.summary: 此卦信实莫信虚之象。所祈求之事应保持现状为宜。

verse: A false promise made in exchange for protection,
Safe and sound you are but yet the promise is not filled.
Heaven’s grace should be repaid and not forgotten,
Thou shalt not treat God so carelessly.
interpretation: To each his own counsel, there is no need to panic.
Follow through to the end what the Goddess of Mercy tells you to do, do not belittle the advice you have received.
meaning: Believe what is real and ignore what is false.
It is better to let things remain as is.
en.explain: I once made a vow to get protection. Now that I am safe, but I did not repay that promise to the heavenly deities.  Do not forget to repay your vows, also necessary to know that the original oath cannot be ignored casually.
divination: This is a neutral lot.
When you see what others have, do not be too anxious to possess them too. However, for Guan Yin Bodhisattva's instructions, you should not be slack nor forget to take it to heart.
items: Reprint Buddhist scriptures To gather wisdom & blessings
Be content with what you have
Stay as now & continue to work hard

notes: Both pages have an extra item 迁徙搬家 / 'Migrating and moving house' not in lot 1. zh key printed 畜养动物 (lot 1 has 家养动物). en 'Self' value wraps to a new line starting with capital 'To gather wisdom & blessings'; capital T kept as printed. en key printed 'Traveller' (lot 1 'Travel'). Double spaces in en explain and 'Propitious to  face West' are as printed.

zh.explain: 正要遗世隐居学神仙，不料得到重用。就像日月当空光照天下，心地正直也必定能声名遍天下。
divination: 此签为上签。
做事要有始有终，不要左右摇摆。
心中筹划的事情，必定会得到众多贵人相助。
zh.summary: 此卦贵人接引之象。所祈求之事若能合情合理、和合处理则大吉大利。

verse: On the way to the mountains to learn celestial ways,
Yet the King stops and summons you.
In clear skies, the Sun and the Moon beam on you,
Your righteous heart and name spread across the four seas.
interpretation: Always complete what you have started, do not be distracted.
No matter what burdens your mind, others will step up to assist you.
meaning: Someone of power and prestige will show you the way.
Everything will be in harmony and auspicious.
en.explain: Just when you are thinking of going to the mountains to learn the celestial ways, unexpectedly you get an important job.  Just like the light of the sun and moon shining on the world, an honest, righteous heart will surely be famous all over the world.
divination: This is an auspicious lot.
Always complete what you have started, do not be swayed or distracted.
Whatever you plan, there will be many noble people to assist you.
items: There will be a good harvest

notes: Extra item 迁徙搬家 / 'Migrating and moving house' on both pages. zh key printed 畜养动物. en key 'Traveller'. en Husbandry printed 'Victorious' (zh says 兴盛), copied as printed. Poem line 2 printed 此知 (not 岂知), copied as printed.

zh.explain: 梧桐落叶，秋天即将过完，归程顺畅快如云飞。感谢天公赐予洪福，才这么一帆风顺，满载财宝而归。
divination: 此签为上签。
心中所盼望的事情，上天一定会满足。
至于经营谋生之类的事情，则尽可大胆地放手去做。
zh.summary: 此卦梧桐叶落之象。所祈求之事先有凶险，之后会吉祥。

verse: As autumn leaves fell from phoenix trees,
The travellers journey home like fleeting clouds.
Thankful for the blessings from almighty Heavens,
A ship laden with treasures sails with good winds.
interpretation: Your intention will be supported by Heavens.
Carry out your tasks and duties to the best of your efforts.
meaning: Leaves falling from phoenix trees.
Things may initially appear unfavorable but will eventually turn well.
en.explain: Leaves have fallen from the sycamore tree, signifying autumn is about to end, travellers return home smoothly like the flying clouds. Thanks to the almighty heavenly deity for the blessings, so that the ship can return home so smoothly, laden with treasures.
divination: This is an auspicious lot.
Whatever one wishes, it will be fulfilled by Heaven. For matters relating to running your own business, be courageous and do your best.
items: Accumulate merits, pray for protection & blessings
Increase your wealth & wisdom by reprinting Buddhist scriptures
Have results after your own heart
Able to use your talents & be appreciated

notes: Both pages omit the 寻失物 / 'Missing things' item (17 items, not 18) and include extra 迁徙搬家 / 'Migrating and moving house'. zh key printed 畜养动物; en key 'Traveller'. 'The travellers journey' printed without apostrophe.

zh.explain: 烈日炎炎像漫天火焰，莲花就生长在这酷热之中。它终究没有受到危害，根基未动，枝叶也依然茂盛。
divination: 此签为中签。
虽然遇到危险，却不会损伤根本。
细心的谋划和所要做的事情，都能得到贵人的帮助。
zh.summary: 此卦火里生莲之象。所祈求之事看似凶险，实则并不凶险。

verse: The fierce flames scorched the sky,
Consumes all but a stalk of water-lily.
Unscathed and unharmed till the end,
It begins to blossom once again.
interpretation: Although there is danger, you will not be harmed.
You will receive help from benefactors when managing your affairs.
meaning: The lotus survives the flames of the fire; you can still be safe even if the conditions are hazardous.
en.explain: The scorching sun is like a fire in the sky and the lotus grows in such scorching heat. But it is ultimately not harmed by the flame, its roots remain firm and its leaves still lush.
divination: This is a neutral lot.
Although there is danger, you are unharm.  Carefully plan what you set out to do and you will surely receive help from benefactors.
items: There will be ups and downs, so be cautious
Must work extra hard, else will not advance
Do vast offerings for blessings and dedications

notes: Extra item 迁徙搬家 / 'Migrating and moving house' on both pages. zh key printed 畜养动物; en key 'Traveller'. en verse line 1 ends with a slightly odd comma glyph (looks like a full-width/Chinese-font comma), transcribed as ','. Printed typos kept: 'you are unharm', 'Have False alarm'.

zh.explain: 譬如初三初四初五，月亮半有半无，缺损而不圆满。待到十五夜间，便会圆月当空，到处都光明。
divination: 此签为中签。
保持现状等待时机，就像每月初几里的月亮一样。
待到一切条件成熟之时，就不会有不吉利的情况发生了。
zh.summary: 此卦月缺未圆之象。所祈求之事必须静候时机才会吉利。

verse: On the third, fourth, fifth, a crescent,
Half present and sometimes absent.
Until the night of the fifteenth,
Round and full, it brightens up the sky.
interpretation: Bide your time.
As the new moon emerges, wait for it to reach its fullness, then things will proceed as you desire.
meaning: The new moon gradually reaches its fullness again.
Things will turn out well if you only wait.
en.explain: On the lunar 3rd, 4th and 5th of the month, the moon is crescent-shaped and not full. Until the 15th night, then the  moon becomes full, with its light shining bright and clear.
divination: This is a neutral lot.
Maintain status quo and wait for the right opportunity, just like a new moon at the beginning of every lunar month. When the right conditions appear, mishaps will not happen.
items: Need to make a promise to the Bodhisattvas
Time is not ripe, do not rush
Do vast offerings for blessings and dedications

notes: Extra item 迁徙搬家 / 'Migrating and moving house' on both pages. zh key printed 畜养动物; en key 'Traveller'. Double space 'then the  moon' in en explain is as printed. 'Bide your time.' split as its own sentence in interpretation.

zh.explain: 为了名声而丧失品德的事怎么能做，恐怕即使是吉祥的事也会变得很凶险。就像喝醉酒的人分辨不出方向，在迷林中朦胧地做梦。
divination: 此签为下签。
鱼儿离开了寒冷的水里，水的表面看上去很平静，却暗藏凶险。
如果要问心中想要做成的事，还不如不去动这个心思。
items: 此签所昭示的是，在这六甲所指的时间里，煞气都很旺盛。因此做任何事情都不吉利，需要做法事来禳除灾祸，以保平安。（“六甲”是古人用天干地支相配来计算时日的方式。其中有甲子、甲戌、甲申、甲午、甲辰和甲寅。）
zh.summary: 此卦寒鱼离水之象。所祈求之事不宜改动。

verse: A fame built on tainted deeds,
Such deeds corrupt all that is good.
A drunkard knows not where to go.
Wonders at a loss among the shadows of pines.
interpretation: The fish out of its icy waters, the situation is imperfect.
If you are planning something, you are advised to stop.
meaning: Like a fish isolated from icy waters, one should not make any move.
en.explain: How can one do things against one's morals for the sake of fame? By doing so, even an auspicious matter may become very dangerous, just as drunkards who can't tell the direction, dreaming hazily in the lost woods.
divination: This is an inauspicious lot.

The situation depicts a fish that has left the icy cold water. The surface of the water may look tranquil, yet it conceals hidden danger beneath. If you are asking about something that you plan to accomplish, you will be better off not having these thoughts.
items: This lot infers that during the  times ruled by “Liujia“, the evil energy is very strong, so it is unlucky to do anything, and it is necessary to do puja to avoid calamities and keep safe. (“Liujia” is used in ancient times to refer to the six particular Heavenly and Earthly branches).

notes: SPECIAL LAYOUT: neither page has the usual 事项 / Celestial Message key-value list. Both instead print a single paragraph about 六甲 (Liujia) inauspicious times plus a parenthetical gloss. Stored as one pseudo-pair with the section label as key (['事项', text] / ['Celestial Message', text]); zh text joins the main paragraph (2 printed lines) and the smaller-font parenthetical without separator. zh shiyi line 1 ends with 。 (not ，) as printed. en: closing quote after the first Liujia is printed as an opening quote (“Liujia“), double space 'during the  times', and 'Wonders' (for wanders) in verse, all kept as printed.

zh.explain: 云雾笼罩，前途迷茫，春尽花谢又再开。如果现在的酣梦能被诗书唤醒，再遇贵人指引便必定能步入仙境。（“天台”指天宫或天台山。）
divination: 此签为中签。
若是老年人求得此签，则会获得第二春。
想要求问功名利禄，则要晚年才可获得意外的财富。
items: 宜多用功，没有不劳而获
zh.summary: 此封春尽花开之象。所祈求之事会在以后的某时有所改善。

verse: Dark clouds and fogs shroud the mountain path.
Flowers wither and bloom again when spring is nearing its end.
As families unite, the moon is full again.
If you wake now from a deep poetic dream,
You will be led to the steps of Heaven.
interpretation: The aged will bloom again as what remains after Spring does.
If you seek fame and fortune, you may claim a large fortune in later years.
meaning: End of Spring as flowers bloom.
Things will prove promising in the end after a change.
en.explain: Dark clouds and mist shroud the road ahead, the future is indistinct, flowers wither and bloom again when spring is nearing its end. If you can wake up from your current poetic dream, and once again receive a nobleman’s guidance, then you will surely enter into a Heavenly paradise.
divination: This is a neutral lot.
If an elderly person receives this lot, he or she will have a second chance at romance. If you seek fame and wealth, then you may get unexpected fortune in your later years.
items: Need to put in efforts to get returns
Work harder, there is nothing for free
Put in all efforts to achieve

notes: zh shiyi and summary print 此封 (封, likely typo for 卦; confirmed by zoom), copied as printed. zh explain includes the printed parenthetical gloss （“天台”指天宫或天台山。）. Extra item 迁徙搬家 / 'Migrating and moving house' on both pages; zh key 畜养动物; en key 'Traveller'. en Lot Verse has 5 clauses (extra line 'As families unite, the moon is full again.' with no zh counterpart). en section label printed 'Divination of The' (missing 'Lot').

zh.explain: 春来花开辉映门庭，招贤车来时财宝随至。如果龙门涌起波浪，就会身化为龙，像一声春雷名扬天下。
divination: 此签为上签。
若从政走仕途，能够得到职位；若是贫穷则可获得财宝，谋划展望未来的事业，也可以称心如意。这是所有卦中第一位的好卦。
items: 此签所昭示的神机是从心所欲，万事都吉祥顺利。
zh.summary: 此卦上朝见帝之象。所祈求之事非常吉祥。

verse: On the balcony, the flowers bloom as Spring arrives.
Treasures brought by vessels from miles away.
Once over the dragon’s gate, the waves surged thrice,
Shakes the earth like a sudden clap of thunder.
interpretation: The emperor has appointed you.
This is like receiving endless wealth.
Everything will work out for the best.
This Lot is the best of all.
meaning: An appointment conferred by the emperor (someone in higher authority).
Everything will be very auspicious and favorable.
en.explain: Spring flowers bloom and brighten your door, and a chariot arrives, bringing loads of treasure. If a big wave surges at the dragon's gate, you will swiftly rise like a dragon, like a clap of thunder that brings you fame to the world.
divination: This is an auspicious lot.

If you go into politics or government service, you can get a position; if you are poor you will receive treasure, and all plans for your future All things will work out to be the best, this is the best lot of all.
items: Reveals the divine sign that you can do whatever you wish, and everything will be auspicious and smooth.

notes: SPECIAL LAYOUT: neither page has the usual 事项 / Celestial Message key-value list; each has one sentence instead, stored as a single pseudo-pair keyed by the section label. zh shiyi line 1 ends with 。 as printed. en divination has a printed run-on 'all plans for your future All things...' (missing punctuation, capital A), kept as printed.

jieyue: 另：困厄之境。无处安身。求神庇佑。祈可放心。
zh.explain: 才行至半山腰，太阳便要下山了，在悬崖陡岩间行走，不要期望会很平安。只有仰头祈求上天保佑，才可能平平安安。
divination: 此签为中签。
如果想要凿开石头见到宝玉，淘尽黄沙见到黄金，则必须下大功夫，
当然这更是费心劳力的事情了。
items: 到达目的地的时间延迟
zh.summary: 此卦淘沙见金之象。所祈求之事有显贵腾达的兆头。

verse: One is barely half-way up the mountains when the sun begins to set.
Dangerously stranded among perilously steep cliffs,
Skyward, one looks to heaven for protection,
And refuge on earth will soon be given.
interpretation: Jade is revealed only after the stone is chiseled.
Gold is found after the sand is sifted.
You need to put in some effort.
(Alternative: Trapped in a bad situation with no safe place to hide. Seek protection from the Gods and you would be fine.)
meaning: Sifts the sand to find gold for one caught in a dangerous situation.
A good omen where you can expect help from someone of influence.
en.explain: The mountaineer only reaches the middle ridge when the sun begins to set, so do not expect to be safe when walking along the steep perilous cliffs. The only way to be safe and sound is to pray for blessings to Heaven and ask the gods for help.
divination: This is a neutral lot.
If you want to chisel the stone to see the precious jade, pan the sand to see the gold, you need to make great efforts.
Of course this is Of course, this is more labour-intensive.
items: Do good, pray for blessings & protection
Don't be too hasty, be cautious

notes: zh 解曰 has an extra smaller line '另：困厄之境。无处安身。求神庇佑。祈可放心。' below the four half-lines; added as a 5th jieyue string. en Interpretation has a matching parenthetical '(Alternative: ...)' kept as its own string. zh item keys differ from usual: 官司状况 (not 官司诉讼), 疾病情况 (not 治病健康); 畜养动物; extra 迁徙搬家. zh divination line 2 ends with ， then a deliberate line break, kept as 3 entries. en verse line 2/3 printed as 'cliffs,  Skyward' (double space, capital S mid-line) split at the clause. en divination printed duplication 'Of course this is Of course, this is more labour-intensive.' kept as printed. en key 'Traveller'.

zh.explain: 木雕的老虎在富贵人家的门口立着，虽然有威风，却不会害人。明知是没有妨害的，为什么还要迟疑恐惧，忧心忡忡。
divination: 此签为中签。
犹如炉火上面的一点雪花，或是耳旁的一阵风，虽然看似有些危害，却会自然消于无形。所以应当往好处想，一切都会解决，前面貌似凶险，而结果则会很吉利。
items: 继续坚持努力，将获更大成就
zh.summary: 此卦木虎有威之象。所祈求之事会虚惊一场，而不会有实质性的危害。

verse: A wooden tiger stands at the gate,
Fierce it may look but harm it will not inflict.
Obviously there is no threat,
Worries, fears and suspicions are all unfounded.
interpretation: Snowflakes on a hot stove, winds that brushed against the ears, things will pass quickly.
You should do more good deeds and fortune will soon follow despite your earlier mishaps.
meaning: A wooden tiger statue just looks fierce and imposing.
There are false alarms as not much is real.
en.explain: A wooden tiger stands at the front door of a wealthy house. Although it looks imposing and ferocious, it is harmless. Since there is no threat of danger, why worry, fear, be suspicious and afraid.
divination: This is a neutral lot.

Like some snowflakes falling onto a hot stove or a gust of wind in the ear, although the outlook seems dangerous, it will disappear naturally. Thus, think positively, and problems will be resolved. What appears to be dangerous. the outcome will eventually be auspicious.
items: Although face difficulties, it can be overcomed
Continue to work hard and get greater achievements

notes: Extra item 迁徙搬家 / 'Migrating and moving house' on both pages; zh key 畜养动物; en key 'Traveller'. en key printed 'Academic & examination' (ampersand). Printed typos kept: 'dangerous. the outcome' (period + lowercase), 'overcomed', 'need to recuperated well'. zh shiyi line 1 ends with 。 as printed.

zh.explain: 在家和在外的谋求都必定大吉大利，现在却像无暇宝玉一样藏在石中。如果遇到贵人指引，那时定会升官发财，风光无限。
divination: 此签为上签。
像石头中埋藏的宝玉，须有贵人来发现，才能获得称心如意的地位和重视。
zh.summary: 此卦石藏珍宝之象。所祈求之事能称心如意，非常吉祥。

verse: Plans and schemes are faring well.
Like rare jade concealed in a stone,
If led by a man of wealth and power,
You will receive jewels and treasures.
interpretation: Like jade hidden in a stone, someone will guide you to fulfill your destiny.
You will be happy and delighted.
meaning: Gems hidden in the stones, everything is auspicious and according to your heart’s desires.
en.explain: Everything is thriving for you, be it at home or outside, like a flawless gem embedded in a rock. If you receive guidance from a benefactor, you will definitely enjoy higher status, make a fortune and shine with infinite beauty.
divination: This is an auspicious lot.
You are like a precious jade buried in the stone, a benefactor needs to discover you, so you can gain the status and recognition according to your wishes.
items: Need to put in some efforts.
Use your talents to your best ability
Study progress to the next level

notes: jieyue 得祇称心: glyph read as 祇 (could be intended 祗; no bottom dot visible at zoom). zh item 寻失物 is printed with a semicolon (寻失物；还在) instead of a colon; key/value split anyway. zh explain prints 无暇 (for 无瑕; the poem uses 瑕), kept as printed. Extra item 迁徙搬家; zh key 畜养动物; en key printed 'Migrating/move house' (not 'Migrating and moving house'); en key 'Traveller'.

zh.explain: 忽然一道好消息普天飞传，却是满载财宝衣锦还乡。如果要问未来还能有多大成就，前进途中还会遇到贵人提携。
divination: 此签为上签。
如果询问前程功名，还会遇到贵人相助，将更添欢欣之事，以至于财禄丰盈，富贵绵长。
items: 此签所昭示的是诸事吉祥，所求的事也必定十分顺利。
zh.summary: 此卦功名成就之象。所祈求之事可以放心大胆地去做，一切都会大吉大利。

verse: A message sent suddenly from the heavens,
And ships return with treasures piled high as mountains.
If you seek to know what good things lie at the fore,
Then be told that help from someone will push you forth.
interpretation: If you are seeking fame and fortune, go ahead where you will find help.
The situation is made more joyous as wealth and treasures abound everywhere.
meaning: You will have both achievements and fame.
You should continue to go forward and do not hesitate.
en.explain: A sudden good news from the heavens, it is a home- coming full of treasures. If you want to ask how much you can achieve in the future, you will meet noble people to help you along the way.
divination: This is an auspicious lot.
If you ask about your future prospects of fame and fortune, you will meet benefactors who will come to your aid, have even more joyful events, wealth and prosperity.
items: This Lot indicates that everything will be good and auspicious. Whatever you wish for will be realised.

notes: 事项 / Celestial Message on both pages is a single free-text sentence, not key/value pairs; stored as one pair with an empty key. EN explain keeps the image's 'home- coming' spacing.

zh.explain: 善于调整心态，就会超越众人，前景更会因此改变，财富也会变得更加丰盈。面对宽阔的大路，如果能施舍此钱财，心情自会更加欢畅。
divination: 此签为中签。
面前是一条大道，尽可前行，无须担忧。
心中所希望要做的事情，也只管用心去做。
items: 此签昭示的是诸事如心，一切顺利，吉祥而且昌盛。
zh.summary: 此卦前途显达之象。所祈求之事会顺畅通泰，非常吉祥。

verse: Unfold your frowns and step up,
Your future will change and wealth will beckon.
Along a wide path broad as the sky,
Give what you have and paths will open.
interpretation: Move ahead along a wide road without any hesitation.
Whatever you plan for, just proceed, things will progress.
meaning: A sign that your future is illustrious and you may gain influence.
Everything will be smooth sailing and very auspicious.
en.explain: Be adept at adjusting your mind-set and you will surpass everyone else, the outlook will change and wealth will become more abundant. The road ahead is broad, and if you can practice generosity and donate money, you will feel even more joyous.
divination: This is a neutral lot.
Ahead is a wide clear path, you can move forward without any worries. Proceed whole-heartedly on what you have set out to accomplish.
items: Whatever you wish for will materialise. Everything will be smooth sailing and auspicious.

notes: 事项 / Celestial Message on both pages is a single free-text sentence, not key/value pairs; stored as one pair with an empty key. zh.explain reads 施舍此钱财 as printed.

zh.explain: 从小经商谋划都十分如意，财禄丰盈也从无苦恼。如果要只身去谋求事业，也必定是秀才出去成为状元，自会功成名就。
divination: 此签为上签。
从小到大，顺顺利利，没有什么阻碍。
有意去追求的事情，都可顺心如意，获得成功。
zh.summary: 此卦自小为商之象。所祈求之事如果勤奋节俭地去做，可永保无忧无愁。

verse: A merchant since young built his experience
Earned fortunes and riches with little help.
If another path is now sought,
The scholar will return with honors.
interpretation: One has encountered few obstacles and troubles since young.
Fame and honor will be as desired if the business and affairs continue to be managed well.
meaning: An industrious merchant since young.
A fortuitous life built on diligence and frugality.
en.explain: A merchant since young, thus he has lots of experience, amassing abundant wealth & fortune with little effort. If you wish to go into business, you will definitely be a scholar and return with honours and fame.
divination: This is an auspicious lot.
Throughout your life, every undertaking has been smooth and without any obstacles. All your future undertakings will similarly be easily accomplished and successful as desired.

notes: 18 items (extra 迁徙搬家 / Migrating and moving house vs lot 1). zh key is 畜养动物 (not 家养动物); en key is 'Traveller' (not 'Travel').

zh.explain: 高翔的鸾凤被雨淋湿了羽翼，反而被蓬间的雀鸟欺侮。但一切终究会有云开雨霁的时候，到时仍能重振羽翼胜过百鸟。
divination: 此签为中签。
周围的小人日渐得志，是君子便不要强行有所作为。
只宜坚守本性，等待时机来临时才去一展身手。
items: 宜多防护，注意调养身体
坚持努力而有更大成就
zh.summary: 此卦鸾凤被雨之象。所祈求之事需等待时机的来临，必定会顺利。

verse: The phoenix‘s distinguished feathers soak with rain,
Even the common bird mock and laugh at him.
Suddenly the rains cease and the sky is clear again,
Its plumage continues to be a regal feather robe.
interpretation: When vile people call the shots, you should do nothing but retreat and wait until things are in your favor again.
meaning: A majestic bird is soaked in the rain.
Wait for a more favorable moment to come.
en.explain: The soaring phoenix's feathers were drenched by the rain, they were even mocked by the common birds in the canopy. But these will pass when the rain stops and the sky clears, then they will once again revive their regal feathers to regain their position above all other birds.
divination: This is a neutral lot.

As vile people around you grow more ambitious day by day, a gentleman like you should not impose your standards or force your way through. Instead, it is better to stick to your own duty and wait for the right opportunity to display your skills.
items: Take more care  and pay attention to regulate your body
Continue to work hard and get greater achievements

notes: 18 items incl. 迁徙搬家 / Migrating/moving house. EN verse line 1 prints a left single quote in phoenix‘s (kept). EN Birth value has a double space ('care  and') as printed.

zh.explain: 君子不要做出小人的行为，如果处事出了差错也会惹来是非。琴要弹给懂音乐的人听，如果自己能静心安守，也许会等来贵人的帮助。
divination: 此签为下签。
一切事情，只有在面对知音时才可以应允。至于闲事，更是不要去理睬。
待到时机成熟，得到贵人相助，自然一切都会欢喜。
items: 不利。宜和合共识做决定。
zh.summary: 此卦要逢知己之象。所祈求之事宜怀着耐心而坚守常态，则会吉祥。

verse: The virtuous think not like the villains,
Whose conduct shows their faults and differences.
Only the tutored will appreciate the fine music,
Remain and quietly wait for the rare company.
interpretation: Stay away from gossips and wait for a mutual friend who knows and understands you and brings joy to you.
meaning: One will meet a genuine and mutual friend.
Maintain things as-is and everything will turn out right.
en.explain: A gentleman should not behave like a villain. If things go wrong, it might also invite trouble. Play the qin only to people who appreciate music. Keep a quiet vigil and perhaps benefactors may come to your aid.
divination: If it’s a bosom friend, you can agree to their requests on all matters, and ignore other idle matters. When the right time comes & you can get a benefactor’s help, naturally everything will be joyous.
items: Don't act rashly, keep the status quo
Be law-abiding, wait for the opportunity
Need a good Doctor otherwise will have obstacles

notes: zh item 出门在外 uses a full-width semicolon (出门在外；还在途中) instead of a colon in the image; key/value split anyway. EN Divination lacks the usual opening 'This is an inauspicious lot.' line (zh has 此签为下签。). EN mixes straight and curly apostrophes as printed.

zh.explain: 有志向和才气的人，追求功业，应当天天努力，从现在起就不要贪酒恋色。如果某天有喜讯传来，钱财福禄可以随你挑选。
divination: 此签为中签。
一方面要心怀高远的志向，另一方面也要脚踏实地，安守自己的本分。
等到金鸡报语，喜讯来临，便没有不令人欢悦的事情了。
zh.summary: 此卦志气功名之象。所祈求之事宜坚守常态，则会非常吉祥。

verse: Rome was not built in a day.
Let no woman nor wine bury your way.
Rises to work when the golden rooster crows,
Money and fortune will soon be called.
interpretation: Determine your goals, keep at it.
Diligence will be rewarded.
The golden rooster calls and happiness will come.
meaning: Work hard to fulfill your ambitions.
Maintain things as-is and everything will turn out very well.
en.explain: Those with ambitions and talents, in pursuit of merits & accomplishments, should work diligently daily. From now on, they should stay away from alcohol and women. When good news comes, you can pick and choose your wealth and happiness.
divination: This is a neutral lot.

While you can have high aspirations, you also need to keep your feet firmly planted on the ground ie. be realistic, and do your duty. When the golden rooster brings good news, everything will be joyous and blissful.
items: Accumulate merits, pray for protection & blessings.

notes: 17 items: no 出门在外 / Travel item on either page; adds 迁徙搬家 / Migrating and moving house. zh keys differ from usual: 官司情况 (not 官司诉讼), 疾病情况 (not 治病健康), 畜养动物.

zh.explain: 高高的宝塔神异奇特，八面透亮，永放光芒。劝您多多虔诚地顶礼膜拜，多做善事，上天自会赐给您幸福吉祥。
divination: 此签为上签。
世上的这些福分，大家都是经常见到的。
不要劳心费力地追求，一切都是人在前世就修定了的。
zh.summary: 此卦福德现身之象。所祈求之事非常吉祥顺利。

verse: The majestic pagoda is more than ordinary,
In all directions, it glows exquisitely.
Steel your mind to worship and do more good,
Heaven will reward your charity with fortune.
interpretation: Your share of fortune is much the same as others.
Do not fret as this is all preordained.
meaning: The signs of fortune and prosperity, everything will go very well.
en.explain: Unique and extraordinary, the majestic pagoda stands tall, shining constantly in all 8 directions with brilliance. It is advisable for you to devote yourself to earnest worship, do more virtuous deeds, then Heaven will naturally bless you with good fortune and happiness.
divination: This is an auspicious lot.
All these worldly good fortunes, everyone sees it frequently. Do not expend a great deal of effort chasing after it. Everything is predestined in previous life.
items: Need to make vow before Bodhisattva
Best to print sutras to increase merits & wisdom
Cultivate merits & wisdom to help in exams
Do vast offerings for blessings and dedications

notes: 17 items: no 寻失物 / Missing things item on either page; adds 迁徙搬家 / Migrating and moving house. zh jieyue prints 福份 while divination prints 福分 (both kept as printed).

zh.explain: 对着风点蜡烛当然点不燃，即使点燃了，烛光疏影，如同镜中的恍惚之花。儿童看了几度要来收拾，但这一切只是收获虚名幻影而已。
divination: 此签为中签。
富贵由天注定，贫穷为命中带来，不需要尽心费力地去追求谋划，
一切都是前世已经确定了的。
zh.summary: 此卦当风点烛之象。所祈求之事如果是为了贪图虚名，则不吉利。

verse: Fleeting shadows cast by a candle in the wind,
Reflect in the mirror like a bed of many flowers.
Mystified, the child wants to keep the flowers,
Only to find that these are only virtual and unreal.
interpretation: It is predestined how wealth is distributed and Who will be poor.
Since it’s already decided, it is pointless to seek anything.
meaning: As a lighted candle flickers in the wind, it is not good to aim for an empty title.
en.explain: It is not possible to light a candle in the wind. Even if one manages to do so, the candle flame will only cast fleeting shadows, like vague reflections of flowers in a mirror. Children would look at it several times and want to pick it up, but this is all an illusion.
divination: This is a neutral lot.
Wealth is predestined by Heaven. Poverty is brought about by one's fate. There is no need to waste your effort in pursuing and scheming. Everything has been determined by your past lives.
items: Accumulate merits, pray for protection & blessings.
Migrating and moving house:  Maintain status quo
Do sincere repentance to clear obstacles

notes: EN items: image prints one merged line 'Change:  Migrating and moving house:  Maintain status quo' (Change has no value of its own); kept literally as a single Change pair, so EN has 17 items vs zh 18 (zh 转换变更 = 不变为上). EN 'Missing person: No sign of' is truncated in the image. zh keys 官司情况, 疾病情况. zh divination: second line ends with a comma and the image breaks the line there; kept as a separate array element. EN interpretation capitalises 'Who' mid-sentence as printed.

zh.explain: 在外在家谋事都要慢慢来，只怕过分着急会引起太多忧虑，招来麻烦。其结果必定如鸟儿飞进罗网里，摆脱困境要多少时日也未可知。
divination: 此签为下签。
保持原有的正常状态，随机缘变化而变化，以等待贵人出现。
如果询问诸般事情的吉凶，则一定要迟稳，不可急躁冒进。
items: 疾病难康复，需长期作战
zh.summary: 此卦守旧随缘之象。所祈求之事不太如意，有凶险之兆。

verse: Delay the journey to seek your fortune,
Haste may breed grief and follies.
Like a bird which has fallen into a waiting net,
To escape will take much time.
interpretation: Remain and wait for your time and help from others.
The advice is all affairs will be late in coming to fruition.
meaning: Stay where you are and be content with what you have.
Situation is ominous and things are not in your favor.
en.explain: Take your time to make plans at all places as haste may give rise to much worries and troubles. The result will certainly be like a bird which has flown into a waiting net,  not knowing how long it will take to be freed from its predicament.
divination: This is an inauspicious lot.

Maintain the normal state that you originally have, change when the opportunity comes, wait for a benefactor to appear. If you are asking about the good or bad of things, then you must be patient, do not be rash and act prematurely.
items: Don't act rashly, keep the status quo
The results are not as good as expected, work harder
Difficult to recover, requires a long-term battle
Pray quickly for blessings & do good

notes: zh 畜养动物 value printed 有损夫 (typo for 有损失), kept as printed. EN 'No news at al' typo kept. EN image runs 'work harder Marriage: Challenging' together on one line; split into separate Academic and Marriage pairs. EN explain has a double space after 'net,' as printed.

zh.explain: 勒住马的缰绳，又想挥鞭径直前冲，如此必定既有忧危又有灾难。正像房屋遭受大火，虽然天降及时大雨，但最后仍将化成灰烬。
divination: 此签为下签。
终身用力去做，不要管别人的是非，否则必会遭遇牢狱灾祸，自己也会后悔不已。
zh.summary: 此卦半忧半喜之象。所祈求之事只适宜行善积德。

verse: Whip in hand, the rider leads the horse and charges ahead,
danger on one side, disaster on the other.
Like a house set on fire,
Heavens will send rain to reduce all to ashes.
interpretation: Work hard the whole life long, caring not for scandals, yet misfortune may still fall upon you out of the blue.
Live and let live so you would be free of these shackles.
meaning: A situation that brings both sorrows and joys.
One should perform more kind deeds.
en.explain: The rider grips the reins of his horse, also thinking of swinging his whip to charge straight ahead. Doing so will certainly bring about sorrow and disaster. This is like a house set on fire. Although timely rain falls from Heaven, the house is ultimately reduced to ashes.
divination: This is an inauspicious lot.
You’ve worked diligently all your life, do not bother about gossip of others, otherwise you will meet with risk of being imprisoned and you will regret it.
items: Do more good deeds and pray for blessings
Do more good deeds, to turn your luck around
Do more good and be patient

notes: 18 items incl. 迁徙搬家 / Migrating and moving house. zh 工作事业 value printed 安耐 (likely for 忍耐/按耐), kept as printed. EN verse line 1 wraps mid-sentence in the image ('...charges / ahead, danger...'); split at the clause comma instead.

zh.explain: 灵通的佛神提醒你，不要愚昧地胡乱论事行事。如果是老年人抽到这一签，便不如守旧以等待时机到来。
divination: 此签为下签。观音灵签至此完满终结，所有神机均已告知。
保持原有的生活状态，不要胡乱改动，静待时机到来。
items: 这是观音签中的满签，诸事都不顺利。应广大行善积德、大做佛事，遵从菩萨的训示，获其神力护佑，方能保证平安。
zh.summary: 此卦守常勿动之象。所祈求之事宜等待时机的来临，则会吉祥。

verse: The Buddhas and Gods have told you of changes to come,
Pay no heed to what the foolish said.
As the aged drew this divine Lot,
Better to leave things as they are and wait.
interpretation: This is the last divine lot.
You have been informed of what you need to know.
Trust in the old and do not move.
Wait patiently and bide your time.
meaning: Stay where you are.
Do not make any move.
Wait until the situation changes in your favor.
en.explain: The spiritual Buddhas and Gods remind you of changes, and not to act foolishly and indiscriminately. If an elderly person draws this divine lot, it is better to remain as present and wait for the right time to come.
divination: This is an inauspicious lot. The Guanyin divine lots have come to an end, and all divine predictions have been revealed.
Keep to your original lifestyle, do not make any random changes and patiently wait for the right opportunity.
items: This lot completes the Guanyin Oracle. When things are unfavourable, do your best to accumulate merits & do good, make vast offerings, pray for blessings, obey the teachings of Buddha & Bodhisattvas so that you may receive their divine protections. You can actively do good deeds, make donations, pray earnestly to Gods and the Buddhas for good outcomes in the future.

notes: Final lot. 事项 / Celestial Message on both pages is free text, not key/value pairs; stored as one pair with an empty key (zh text is printed on 3 lines, EN as 2 paragraphs; joined).
